paper.title: Manifold Drift in Flow Preference Optimization: A Root Cause of Reward Hacking
paper.abstract: Preference optimization is a standard alignment method for generative models, yet extending it to continuous-time dynamics remains non-trivial. In flow matching, reward-driven updates modify transport trajectories without an inherent constraint to the pretrained data manifold and can move terminal samples off the pretrained support. summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 flow matching 模型做 preference optimization 时的一个结构性失效：奖励驱动的更新会改变连续时间 transport trajectory，如果终端位移带有相对预训练数据流形的法向分量，生成结果会离开预训练支持集。作者把这个问题定义为 manifold drift，并将其作为 continuous generative model 中 reward hacking 和样本质量下降的原因之一。
summary.importance: 这是值得精读的工作，因为它把 DPO 从离散 LM 迁移到 diffusion/flow 模型时的风险讲清楚了。离散 LM 的偏好优化主要重排完整输出的概率；flow 或 diffusion 模型的偏好优化会直接改写从噪声到数据的动力学路径。这个差异会影响未来 diffusion LM、flow LM、连续 latent reasoning、AR+diffusion 统一建模中的 RL/post-train 设计。对基座研究员来说，关键启发是：reference model 或 pairwise preference loss 不自动保证表示流形被保留；奖励信号需要和生成先验的几何约束一起设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先从 flow matching 形式化问题。模型学习时间依赖向量场 vθ，把噪声分布 p1 沿 ODE 轨迹输运到数据分布 p0。标准 flow matching 在插值路径 xt 上拟合条件速度。FlowDPO 一类方法无法高效计算连续模型的 exact log-likelihood，于是用 timestep-wise flow regression error 作为 DPO 中 log probability 的 surrogate，在 winner 和 loser 上做成对偏好优化。作者指出，这类 surrogate 会推动向量场朝奖励偏好的方向变化，但没有机制限制终端仍留在预训练数据流形上。理论部分给出核心条件：最优 flow matching 可以恢复终端数据分布；但偏好更新诱导的 terminal displacement 只要存在非零 normal component，就会离开预训练流形。为此，作者提出 ThermoDPO。它在 winner 侧加入 temperature-controlled anchor，把 pairwise preference optimization 锚定到 preferred sample 所在的预训练支持附近。τ→0 时退化为 rejection sampling fine-tuning；τ>0 时可以分解为 temperature-scaled FlowDPO 项加一个非负 anchoring term。这个分解把 reward maximization 和 manifold preservation 的取舍显式化。作者还提出 ThermoDPO-weighted，用重加权处理 t=0 附近权重不稳定的问题，并给出对 reconstruction-based manifold drift surrogate 的上界。
summary.experiments: 实验包含合成流形和真实图像任务。合成实验使用 R3 中的解析曲面 z=f(x,y)：x=±3 附近两个 bump 被设为 preferred，x=0 附近 central dip 为 dispreferred，其余区域中性。所有方法从同一个三层 flow-matching MLP 出发，使用相同 winner–loser pairs，微调预算为 10,000 steps，并在 10,000 个生成样本上评估。点是否在流形上由曲面域约束和 |z−f(x,y)|≤0.15 判定。这个设置直接检验偏好优化是否只把样本推向高奖励区域，还是同时保持在曲面上。真实图像实验将 ThermoDPO-weighted 与 RFT、FlowDPO 及其变体比较，使用自动指标和人工评价。给出的全文片段没有展开具体表格数值，但摘要中的结论是：ThermoDPO-weighted 在提升目标偏好指标的同时，没有明显牺牲视觉质量，相比 FlowDPO 变体有更好的偏好收益与样本保真取舍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论和目标函数推导。第一优先级是 Sec. 3 的 manifold drift 定义与定理，尤其要看 terminal displacement 的法向分量如何对应离开数据流形。第二优先级是 ThermoDPO 的推导：τ→0 为什么对应 RFT，τ>0 为什么能分解成 scaled FlowDPO 加 anchoring term。这个分解是核心创新。第三优先级是 ThermoDPO-weighted，重点看 t=0 附近为什么会出现实践权重问题，以及重加权是否改变理论约束。实验部分先看图 2 和图 3 的 toy manifold，它们比图像样例更直接展示 failure mode；再看真实图像任务中的目标指标、质量指标和人工评价是否一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural failure mode in preference optimization for flow matching models. Reward-driven fine-tuning modifies the continuous transport dynamics from noise to data. If the induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component relative to the pretrained data manifold, generated samples can move off the pretrained support. The authors call this failure mode manifold drift and connect it to reward hacking and degraded sample quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong read for researchers working on pretraining and post-training interfaces. DPO for discrete language models mostly reweights completed outputs, while preference optimization for flow or diffusion models changes the generative trajectory itself. That distinction matters for diffusion language models, flow-based language models, continuous latent reasoning, and unified AR-diffusion training. The main lesson is that a reference model or a pairwise preference objective does not automatically preserve the pretrained generative prior. Reward optimization needs an explicit mechanism that respects the geometry of the learned data manifold.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from standard flow matching. A time-dependent vector field vθ transports a simple prior p1, usually noise, to the data distribution p0 through an ODE. Standard training fits the conditional velocity along interpolation paths. FlowDPO-style methods avoid exact likelihood computation by replacing log probabilities with timestep-wise flow regression errors, then applying a DPO-like pairwise objective to winner and loser samples. The paper shows why this can be unsafe: the preference update can alter the terminal endpoint of the flow in directions that are normal to the pretrained data manifold. Optimal flow matching recovers the terminal data distribution, but a preference update leaves the manifold whenever its induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component. ThermoDPO addresses this by adding a temperature-controlled winner-side anchor. As the temperature τ goes to zero, the objective recovers rejection sampling fine-tuning. For τ>0, it decomposes into a temperature-scaled FlowDPO term plus a nonnegative anchoring term. This makes the alignment–preservation trade-off explicit. The weighted variant, ThermoDPO-weighted, fixes practical weighting issues near t=0 and comes with a bound on a reconstruction-based surrogate for manifold drift.
summary_en.experiments: The synthetic experiment uses an analytic surface z=f(x,y) in R3. Two bumps near x=±3 are preferred, the central dip near x=0 is dispreferred, and the rest of the surface is neutral. All methods start from the same three-layer flow-matching MLP, use the same winner–loser pairs, fine-tune for 10,000 steps, and evaluate 10,000 generated samples. A sample is counted as on-manifold if it lies in the surface domain and satisfies |z−f(x,y)|≤0.15. This setup isolates whether a preference method moves samples toward preferred regions while staying on the surface. Real-image experiments compare ThermoDPO-weighted with RFT, FlowDPO, and related variants using automated and human metrics. The provided text does not include the detailed numerical tables, but the reported conclusion is that ThermoDPO-weighted improves target preference metrics while preserving visual fidelity better than FlowDPO variants.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the theory and objective derivation carefully. The most important part is the manifold drift formalization: track how a terminal displacement with a normal component moves samples off the pretrained support. Then study the ThermoDPO derivation, especially the two limits: τ→0 gives rejection sampling fine-tuning, while τ>0 yields a scaled FlowDPO term plus an anchoring term. The weighted variant is also worth checking because it addresses instability near t=0, which is often where continuous generative training details matter. For experiments, start with Figures 2 and 3 on the toy manifold; they expose the failure mode more cleanly than image examples. Then inspect the real-image tables for the trade-off between preference metrics, fidelity metrics, and human judgments.

recommendation.zh: 把“对齐把模型推离 pretrain 支撑集”讲成可检验的几何条件，属于能改你 DPO/flow 对齐直觉的那类；先读理论条件与温度连接那节，再看漂移度量怎么落地。
recommendation.en: It turns “alignment pushes you off the pretrain support” into a testable geometric condition; read the theory + temperature-bridging part first, then check how the drift surrogate is operationalized.

paper.title: Polaris: Learning to Generate Table Descriptions from Retrieval Feedback
paper.abstract: Many table-centric NLP tasks such as NL2SQL first retrieve relevant tables from large collections using keyword search. Recent work uses LLMs to generate natural-language table descriptions to improve retrieval, but they are typically optimized for fluency rather than retrieval effectiveness. We present Polaris, a system that trains an LLM to generate table descriptions directly from retrieval feedback. Our key insight is that existing table retrieval benchmarks already contain the supervision n

summary.core_problem: 如何让LLM生成的“表格描述”不只追求流畅，而是直接优化下游表检索效果。
summary.importance: 把检索反馈（BM25排名/相关性判断）转成偏好对，用DPO训练生成器；属于“用可得的弱监督信号做偏好优化”的一个干净案例，但更偏应用到表检索管线。
summary.technical_approach: 利用现有表检索benchmark的query-table相关性标注：对每张表生成多候选描述，用BM25检索效果对候选排序，构造偏好对后用DPO微调LLM；并在生成前扩展缩写的表名/列名以减少词汇不匹配。
summary.experiments: 在多个表检索基准上对比AutoDDG等方法，报告Polaris在检索效果上优于SOTA且常有显著提升；摘要未给出具体模型规模/训练token量/提升幅度细节。
summary.authors_note: University of Wisconsin–Madison（AnHai Doan组）

summary_en.core_problem: How to train an LLM to generate table descriptions that optimize table retrieval effectiveness rather than mere fluency.
summary_en.importance: Turns retrieval feedback into preference pairs and applies DPO to a generator; a clean example of leveraging weak, already-available supervision signals, though the contribution is largely pipeline-level for table retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: From existing table-retrieval benchmarks with query–table relevance labels: generate multiple candidate descriptions per table, rank candidates by BM25 retrieval effectiveness, build preference pairs, and fine-tune via DPO; additionally expand abbreviated table/column names to reduce vocabulary mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple table retrieval benchmarks against AutoDDG and others; Polaris improves retrieval and often by a large margin. The abstract does not specify model size, training tokens, or exact deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Wisconsin–Madison (AnHai Doan group)

recommendation.zh: 把“BM25当reward”转成DPO偏好对很实用，但更像检索应用配方；只需看偏好对构造与缩写扩展两点。
recommendation.en: Practical recipe: convert BM25-based retrieval feedback into DPO pairs, but it’s mostly a table-retrieval pipeline; skim the preference construction and abbreviation-expansion trick.

paper.title: HiRoute: Hierarchical Routed Prompt Tuning for Safety Alignment of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to harmful requests and jailbreak attacks. Parameter-efficient safety alignment methods based on prompt tuning typically rely on a single global prompt or externally selected prompt modules. Such static designs struggle to maintain a cross-category safety boundary while generating constructive responses tailored to specific risks and avoiding over-refusal of benign inputs. To address these limitations, we propose HiRoute, an input-adaptive hierarchi

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 安全对齐中静态软提示难以同时覆盖跨类别安全边界、类别化风险响应和低误拒的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练安全对齐方法改进。它不是预训练工作，但讨论了冻结基座模型后的输入自适应控制，对理解轻量安全层、拒答边界和偏好优化有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HiRoute：先用冻结 LLM 的中间表示训练轻量层级路由器，同时做有害意图检测和多标签风险打分；再冻结基座和路由器，用偏好优化与交替梯度更新学习一个共享粗粒度安全提示和多个细粒度提示专家。方法核心是把类别无关的安全控制与类别相关的响应引导拆开。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明面向有害请求、越狱攻击和良性输入误拒进行评估，但给定信息未包含模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。可确认的是实验目标覆盖安全性、越狱鲁棒性和有用性之间的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the weakness of static prompt-tuning safety alignment, where a single global prompt struggles to maintain broad safety boundaries while giving risk-specific helpful responses and avoiding over-refusal.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training safety-alignment contribution rather than a pretraining paper. Its value for a base-model researcher is mainly in how lightweight adaptive control can be layered on top of a frozen LLM and optimized with preference signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiRoute trains a lightweight hierarchical router on representations extracted from a frozen LLM to detect harmful intent and predict multi-label risk scores. It then freezes both the backbone and router, and uses preference optimization with alternating gradient updates to learn a shared coarse-grained prompt plus fine-grained prompt experts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on harmful requests, jailbreak attacks, and benign inputs, but the provided text does not expose model sizes, training data, baseline list, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation axis is the safety-helpfulness-overrefusal trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和偏好优化设定即可；动态安全提示有工程味，但不改变预训练侧的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and preference-optimization setup; the adaptive safety prompt is practical, but it does not move any pretraining prior.

paper.title: Context Blindness in DPO: Mitigating Object Hallucination in MLLMs via Context-Calibrated Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress, yet they still exhibit object hallucination, generating plausible but incorrect descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) mitigates this by training models to prefer non-hallucinated responses over hallucinated ones, and recent efforts further enrich the preference data with relevant context. However, it remains unclear whether DPO actually leverages such context. To investigat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作盯住的不是“如何再造一批更好的偏好数据”，而是一个更基础的问题：现有 DPO 类目标在训练 MLLM 抗幻觉时，是否真的学会了利用额外上下文来增强对正确回答的偏好。论文给出的结论是否定的。作者把这种现象称为 context blindness：即便输入里加入了有助于 grounding 的上下文，标准 DPO 的优化形式也不会显式奖励“有上下文时偏好边际更大”，因此模型学到的偏好常常对上下文不敏感。这一点直接关系到 object hallucination，因为很多幻觉并不是模型不会比较好坏回答，而是它没有把视觉或补充文本上下文真正纳入偏好判断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是基础预训练 recipe 的论文，而是 post-train 对齐目标的诊断与修正工作。但它有两个值得重视的点。第一，它把 DPO 类方法里一个常被忽略的结构性缺陷讲清楚了：pairwise preference loss 只在单一输入条件下拉开 chosen/rejected 的 margin，不会自动鼓励“信息更多时 margin 应更大”。这个观察对多模态对齐、事实性对齐，甚至文本 LLM 的 grounded preference learning 都有参考价值。第二，它提出的 CPG 把“模型是否真的利用上下文”从定性判断变成了可测量量，因而不只是一个新 loss，也是一种训练诊断工具。贡献量级更像是对 DPO 目标函数的有针对性修补，而不是范式替换；但问题抓得准，结论也比较可迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是诊断指标 Contextual Preference Gain, CPG。它衡量同一对回答在“无额外上下文”和“有额外有帮助上下文”两种条件下，模型偏好边际提升了多少。这里的偏好边际沿用 DPO/BT 框架里的 chosen 与 rejected 的相对 reward 或 log-prob gap。若模型真的会利用上下文，那么加入 grounding context 后，正确回答相对错误回答的优势应更明显，CPG 应为正且足够大。作者用这个指标发现：CPG 与 hallucination rate 强负相关，但标准 DPO、以及一些变体的 CPG 分布都集中在 0 附近，说明它们学到的偏好几乎不随上下文增强而增强。

第二层是 C²-DPO。核心做法是在原有 preference objective 之外，加一个 calibration term，显式要求“带上下文时的偏好 margin”大于“无上下文时的偏好 margin”。这样训练信号不再只是 chosen 胜过 rejected，而是进一步要求模型把额外上下文转化为更强的偏好证据。这个设计和普通 DPO 的区别不在于换了 reward parameterization，而在于把 context sensitivity 直接写进目标函数。论文还强调该项可以较平滑地嫁接到 SimPO、RDPO 等变体上，说明它更像一个通用校准项，而不是依赖某个特定 DPO 实现。

从机制上看，这个方法适合处理“正确答案需要 grounding 才能成立”的场景。若 chosen/rejected 在无上下文时已经容易区分，C²-DPO 的增益可能有限；但在视觉细节、事实补充、外部证据这类场景里，它会更自然，因为这些任务的关键不是静态偏好，而是条件化偏好随证据增强而增强。
summary.experiments:
实验主线比较清楚。首先，作者验证 CPG 的诊断价值：更高的 CPG 对应更低的 hallucination rate，这为后续方法提供了因果上较合理的优化方向。其次，在多模态抗幻觉 benchmark 上，C²-DPO 相比基线 DPO 明显降低幻觉。文中给出的代表性结果是：在 Object HalBench 上，response-level hallucination rate 下降 36%，mention-level 下降 60%；在 HallusionBench 上也有一致改善。第三，作者检查了副作用，发现 ScienceQA、MM-Vet、TextVQA 等通用多模态理解任务没有明显退化，说明它不是靠保守回答或压缩输出换来的抗幻觉。

另外两个实验点也值得看。其一，方法可扩展到 SimPO、RDPO，说明收益不依赖某个单一 preference loss。其二，作者还做了 text-only 设置，发现 context-aware preference calibration 对 factual alignment 也有帮助，这一点说明“上下文盲”不是 MLLM 独有问题，而是 DPO 类目标的更一般缺陷。

从你给出的全文片段里，没有看到更细的模型规模、训练样本数、β 或 calibration 系数等完整表格，因此没法安全补具体超参数字。阅读时建议重点核对主表、CPG 分布图、以及不同 DPO 变体上的一致性结果，确认收益是否稳定而非个别 benchmark 偶然。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但有两个部分值得认真看。第一是引言和方法前半段，作者对“为什么标准 DPO 不会自然学到 context gain”的论证比较关键。要看清楚它不是在说 DPO 完全不能利用上下文，而是在说目标函数没有显式奖励 richer-context margin increase，所以这种能力学得不稳、也不充分。第二是 CPG 定义和相关性实验。若你做对齐或偏好建模，这部分比具体 loss 更有复用价值，因为它提供了一个检查模型是否真正使用证据的诊断视角。

实验部分建议优先看三类表：Object HalBench/HallusionBench 主结果，通用能力保持结果，以及把 calibration 项接到 SimPO/RDPO 上的迁移结果。若时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要判断能否迁到文本 factuality 或 RAG preference setting，再补看 text-only 实验和附录里的 loss 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “can better preference data reduce hallucination?” It asks whether DPO-style training actually learns to use additional grounding context when deciding which response should be preferred. The answer is largely no. The authors call this context blindness: standard DPO increases the preference margin between chosen and rejected responses under a fixed input, but it does not explicitly reward the margin becoming larger when more helpful context is provided. For object hallucination in MLLMs, this matters because the failure is often not simple ranking failure; it is failure to condition preference strength on visual or textual evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. It is a post-training alignment paper with direct relevance to grounded modeling. Its value comes from two places. First, it isolates a structural limitation in DPO-like objectives rather than attributing hallucination only to data quality. That diagnosis is useful beyond this benchmark setting, including multimodal alignment, factuality alignment, and any preference setup where evidence should sharpen the model’s confidence. Second, the proposed Contextual Preference Gain (CPG) turns “does the model really use context?” into a measurable quantity. So the contribution is not only a modified loss, but also a diagnostic tool. The scale of contribution is best viewed as a targeted correction to DPO objectives, not a new paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. The first is the diagnostic metric, Contextual Preference Gain (CPG). For the same response pair, the model is evaluated with and without additional helpful context. CPG measures how much the preference margin increases once that context is added. The margin follows the usual DPO or Bradley-Terry view, based on the relative reward or log-probability gap between preferred and dispreferred responses. If a model truly leverages context, the correct response should become more strongly preferred when grounding information is available, so CPG should be positive and meaningfully large. Empirically, the authors show that higher CPG is strongly associated with lower hallucination, while standard DPO and several variants produce CPG distributions concentrated near zero.

The second layer is C²-DPO. On top of the original preference objective, the authors add a calibration term that explicitly rewards the preference margin under enriched context being larger than the margin without that context. This is the key difference from vanilla DPO. The change is not about a new reward parameterization; it is about writing context sensitivity directly into the optimization target. The same idea is also attached to SimPO and RDPO, which suggests that the proposal is a fairly general calibration add-on rather than a method tied to one specific DPO implementation.

Mechanistically, the method is well matched to settings where the preferred answer is only clearly preferred once grounding evidence is present. If chosen and rejected responses are already easy to separate without extra context, the gain may be limited. But for visual grounding, factual evidence, and other evidence-conditioned preference tasks, the objective is well aligned with the failure mode.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is straightforward. First, the paper validates CPG as a diagnostic: models with higher CPG consistently show lower hallucination rates. That gives the proposed optimization direction a credible empirical basis. Second, C²-DPO reduces hallucination on multimodal benchmarks by a clear margin. The headline numbers reported in the paper are a 36% reduction in response-level hallucination rate and a 60% reduction in mention-level hallucination rate on Object HalBench, with consistent gains on HallusionBench as well. Third, the paper checks whether this comes at the cost of general multimodal ability and reports that performance on ScienceQA, MM-Vet, and TextVQA is preserved.

Two additional results are worth noting. The calibration idea transfers to SimPO and RDPO, which supports the claim that the issue is objective-level rather than implementation-specific. The authors also test a text-only setting and find improved factual alignment there too, suggesting that context blindness is a broader weakness of DPO-style training, not only a multimodal problem.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete hyperparameter tables or all model-scale details, so I would not infer exact training sizes beyond the benchmark-level results already stated. When reading the paper, the main tables to verify are the CPG correlation plots, the hallucination benchmarks, and the cross-objective transfer results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but two parts deserve closer attention. First, read the motivation and the early method section carefully. The important claim is not that DPO cannot use context at all; it is that the objective does not explicitly reward larger preference gains under richer context, so context use is weak and unreliable. Second, focus on the definition of CPG and the correlation analysis. If you work on alignment or preference modeling, that diagnostic may be more reusable than the specific loss.

In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: the main Object HalBench and HallusionBench tables, the capability-retention tables on general multimodal benchmarks, and the results where the calibration term is added to SimPO or RDPO. If time is limited, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to assess transfer to text factuality or retrieval-grounded preference learning, then also read the text-only experiments and the appendix for the exact loss construction.

recommendation.zh: 读 CPG 定义和 ablation 即可；它提醒偏好数据加上下文不等于训练信号真的依赖上下文。
recommendation.en: Read the CPG definition and ablations; the useful warning is that contextual preference data does not imply context-dependent training signal.

paper.title: SAGA: Score-Weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment for Low-Resource Nordic Language Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimisation has proven effective for improving large language models but typically relies on costly human preference annotations. Extending these methods to morphologically rich, low-resource languages remains challenging because such annotations are scarce. We present SAGA (Score-weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment), a parser-guided preference optimisation framework that replaces human labels with dependency-parser supervision. SAGA converts parser judgements into preference pair

summary.core_problem: 在丹麦语、冰岛语、挪威博克mål 等低资源且形态复杂语言中，缺少人工偏好标注导致偏好优化难以落地。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据与监督信号构造。它用依存句法分析器替代人工偏好，为低资源语言 alignment 提供一种较便宜的弱监督路径；对预训练研究的价值主要在于训练信号质量和 reward hacking 监控。
summary.technical_approach: SAGA 将 parser judgement 转换成 delta-DPO 的偏好对，用句法分析质量和词汇多样性组成复合 reward，再用 reward gap 过滤低信息量样本，并显式监控 reward hacking。方法属于把外部语言工具迁移为偏好监督，而不是新的 RL 或 DPO 目标。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GPT-SW3-1.3B，在 Danish、Icelandic、Norwegian Bokmål 上评估语法质量。摘要报告 Danish parse success 从 69.0% 提升到 93.8%，Icelandic 在独立 Stanza 评估上提升 4.5 个百分点；其余 baseline 和完整指标需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses preference optimization for morphologically rich, low-resource Nordic languages where human preference labels are scarce.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training supervision pipeline. It replaces human preferences with dependency-parser-derived signals, which is mainly interesting for thinking about weak preference labels, signal quality, and reward hacking.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGA converts parser judgments into preference pairs for delta-DPO, combines parser quality and lexical diversity into a composite reward, filters low-information pairs by reward gaps, and tracks reward hacking. It adapts existing preference optimization rather than proposing a new alignment objective.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use GPT-SW3-1.3B on Danish, Icelandic, and Norwegian Bokmål. The abstract reports Danish parse success improving from 69.0% to 93.8%, and a 4.5 percentage-point gain for Icelandic on an independent Stanza evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 低资源 alignment 的弱监督例子；只看 reward-gap 过滤和 hacking 监控，别把 parser reward 当通用偏好替代。
recommendation.en: A weak-supervision example for low-resource alignment; read the reward-gap filtering and hacking checks, but do not treat parser reward as a general preference substitute.

paper.title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attrib

summary.core_problem: 在性别歧视检测中保留标注者之间的真实分歧，而不是把分歧压成多数票标签。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练和偏好优化的任务化改造。它对 alignment 的一个小问题有参考意义：偏好数据中的 disagreement 可能不是噪声，而是需要显式建模的多视角信号；但任务范围较窄，离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAP-PO，即先按标注行为聚类标注者，而不是按人口统计属性分组；再为每个聚类微调一个 LLM agent 来复现该群体标注模式；最后用结合个体奖励和团队奖励的 preference optimization 协调多个 agent。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 EXIST 2024 英语和西班牙语推文数据，在两种语言和两种 backbone LLM 上形成四个设置；评估每个 agent 是否复现自身 cluster 的标注，以及多 agent 集体是否复现多数标签。摘要未给出具体模型名称、参数量和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Utrecht University；未见与 LLM 基座预训练相关的代表性团队信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to preserve genuine annotator disagreement in sexism detection instead of collapsing it into a majority-vote label.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task-specific adaptation of preference optimization. It is mildly relevant to alignment because it treats disagreement in preference data as structured signal rather than noise, but the setup remains narrow and far from foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAP-PO first clusters annotators by labeling behavior rather than demographic attributes. It then fine-tunes one LLM agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster’s annotation pattern, and coordinates agents through preference optimization with both individual and team-level rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use the EXIST 2024 English and Spanish tweet dataset, with four settings from two languages and two backbone LLMs. The evaluation checks cluster-level reproduction and majority-label reproduction. The abstract does not provide exact backbone sizes or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Utrecht University; no foundation-model pretraining track record is identifiable from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它把偏好分歧当训练信号，但 sexism 数据集太窄，别外推到通用对齐。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework only: it treats preference disagreement as signal, but the sexism-detection setting is too narrow to generalize.

paper.title: Temporal Concentration from Rollout Errors: Implicit Preference Optimization for Text-to-Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Recent advances in preference alignment for diffusion-based video generation, particularly via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), have significantly improved visual quality. However, temporally sparse artifacts such as motion collapse, object flickering, and color oversaturation remain a major barrier to perceptual realism. Existing methods struggle with these issues due to two key limitations: (1) the preference attribution bottleneck, where offline human annotations are costly and fail to a

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到视频 diffusion 后训练中短时伪影难以归因和难以定向优化的问题，例如 motion collapse、object flickering 和颜色过饱和。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成模型的 preference alignment 方法改进。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对 diffusion 模型如何从生成过程内部构造训练信号有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 concentrated Implicit Preference Optimization，即 cIPO。方法从去噪 rollout 过程本身推导 implicit preference signal，而不是主要依赖离线人工偏好；同时把监督集中到出现短时伪影的时间片段，避免对完整视频均匀施加偏好损失造成 credit misallocation。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是改善 text-to-video diffusion 的时序稀疏伪影，并与现有 DPO 类 preference alignment 方法比较。给出的片段未包含模型规模、训练数据、baseline 数量和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包括 Xintao Wang、Pengfei Wan、Kun Gai 等视频生成和工业推荐/生成系统方向研究者；仅凭摘要无法确认完整机构归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles temporally sparse artifacts in text-to-video diffusion post-training, such as motion collapse, object flickering, and color oversaturation, where attribution and targeted supervision are difficult.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-alignment method for video generation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant as an example of deriving training signals from the generative process itself rather than from external preference labels alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes concentrated Implicit Preference Optimization, or cIPO. The method extracts implicit preference signals from denoising rollouts and concentrates supervision on the short temporal regions where artifacts occur, instead of applying a uniform preference loss to the whole video.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the comparison against DPO-style preference alignment for video diffusion and targets sparse temporal artifacts. The provided text does not include model scale, training data size, exact baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wan, and Kun Gai, who are associated with video generation and large-scale industrial ML work; the full institutional affiliations cannot be confirmed from the given metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 ablation 即可；有用点是把 denoising rollout 当偏好信号源，但离 LLM pretrain 仍隔一层。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; the useful bit is treating denoising rollouts as preference signals, but it remains one step away from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Let Me Look at You: Advanced Facial Expression Modeling for Conversational Speech Synthesis
paper.abstract: Conversational Speech Synthesis is a fundamental component of human-computer interaction, aiming to generate contextually appropriate, expressive, and empathetic speech. However, facial expressions encode subtle and rich affective cues that are crucial for empathetic speech interaction, whereas existing approaches often overlook this important modality. In addition, the lack of large-scale natural conversational datasets with both speech and visual modalities also limits the development of visua

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在对话式语音合成中利用面部表情信息，生成更符合上下文和情感状态的语音。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法与 tokenizer 设计。它不是通用语音 LM 预训练报告，但把 facial expression 离散成 token 并接入 LLM backbone，对统一多模态 tokenization 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FacialTalker，一个 facial-expression-aware conversational speech synthesis 框架。核心组件是 AUTokenizer：用单 codebook 把每帧面部表情离散为紧凑 token，并用 facial Action Unit 组合进行监督训练。还提出 DualDPO，用偏好优化进一步约束生成语音与表情/情感的一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练数据规模、模型参数量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。论文声称针对现有自然对话数据中语音-视觉模态不足的问题进行建模，但具体数据构建细节需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 Inner Mongolia University 和 SRIBD；Haizhou Li 是语音与音频方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to use facial-expression information in conversational speech synthesis to generate speech that better matches context and affect.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method with a tokenizer component. It is not a general speech-LM pretraining report, but its discretization of facial expressions into tokens connected to an LLM backbone is mildly relevant to unified multimodal tokenization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose FacialTalker, a facial-expression-aware conversational speech synthesis framework. Its key component is AUTokenizer, a single-codebook tokenizer that discretizes frame-level facial expressions into compact tokens, trained with supervision from combinations of facial Action Units. The framework also uses DualDPO to improve preference alignment between generated speech and visual-affective cues.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report training-data scale, model size, baseline names, or exact gains. It motivates the work by the lack of large natural conversational datasets with both speech and visual modalities, but the concrete dataset and evaluation details require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Inner Mongolia University and SRIBD; Haizhou Li is a well-known researcher in speech and audio.

recommendation.zh: 看 AUTokenizer 设计即可；TTS 应用味较重，pretrain 侧只借鉴表情离散化。
recommendation.en: Only the AUTokenizer design is worth a look; the work is mostly TTS-oriented, with limited pretraining signal beyond affect tokenization.

paper.title: CANN Bench: Benchmarking Agent Generated Kernels against Real NPU and Algorithmic Limits
paper.abstract: AI agents are now capable of writing, compiling, and iteratively optimizing low-level operator kernels on different hardware platforms. Existing benchmarks, however, focus almost exclusively on CUDA and Triton, leaving hardware ecosystems with less-exposed programming models without a common evaluation baseline. We present CANN Bench, an open benchmark for AI-generated operator code on Huawei's Ascend NPU. The current release covers 53 operators and 1060 test cases organized into four difficulty

summary.core_problem: 现有AI生成算子内核的基准几乎只覆盖CUDA/Triton生态，华为昇腾NPU的CANN编程栈缺乏独立于特定训练配方、覆盖真实生产负载与多精度的统一评测基线，无法客观衡量Agent生成昇腾算子的真实能力。
summary.importance: 为面向NPU的代码生成Agent的SFT/RL训练提供了标准化的反馈信号与评测锚点；其覆盖MoE调度、FlashAttention等LLM训练核心算子的设计，可直接服务于大模型训练栈的算子自动化优化场景；反奖励黑客与持续演进的设计思路对同类基准构建有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 先定义6项设计准则，再构建包含53个算子、1060个测试用例的基准集，按难度分为4档（从逐元素原语到MoE调度、FlashAttention融合算子），覆盖FP16/BF16/FP32/INT4/INT8精度；采用编译通过率、功能正确性、硬件性能三维加权综合评分，任一维度失败会严格限制其余维度得分；每个算子配套规格说明、黄金实现、公开测试用例与性能基线，内置反奖励黑客检测（识别绕过精度断言、硬编码形状、记忆输出等行为），基准任务与协议会随昇腾硬件、CANN版本、模型家族迭代更新。
summary.experiments: 对比现有基准的覆盖缺口：KernelBench、TritonBench等仅支持NVIDIA平台，其分块语义与缓冲结构设计无法直接迁移到昇腾；MultiKernelBench跨平台但昇腾任务深度不足、精度覆盖窄；NPUKernelBench绑定特定AscendKernelGen训练配方，静态形状测试易被形状特化算子绕过。配套方法验证显示，AscendKernelGen在二级难度下Pass@10编译率从0%提升到95.5%，AscendOptimizer在127个cann-ops算子上取得1.19倍几何平均加速。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1.2节的6项设计准则（理解基准设计的核心约束）、第2节的任务分层与三维评分规则、表1的现有基准对比；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，若用于训练代码Agent可进一步查看附录的测试用例规范。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for AI-generated operator kernels almost exclusively target the CUDA and Triton ecosystems. The CANN programming stack for Huawei Ascend NPUs lacks a standardized evaluation baseline independent of specific training recipes, with coverage of real production workloads and multi-precision formats, making it impossible to objectively measure agent capability for Ascend kernel generation.
summary_en.importance: Provides a standardized feedback signal and evaluation anchor for SFT/RL training of code generation agents targeting NPUs. Its coverage of LLM training-critical operators (MoE dispatch, FlashAttention) directly supports automated operator optimization for large model training stacks. The anti-reward-hacking and continuous evolution design offers a reference framework for similar benchmark construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: First defines 6 design criteria, then builds a benchmark with 53 operators and 1060 test cases organized into 4 difficulty tiers (from elementwise primitives to fused operators like MoE dispatch and FlashAttention), covering FP16, BF16, FP32, INT4, INT8 precisions. Adopts a 3-dimensional weighted composite score across compilation pass rate, functional correctness, and hardware performance, where failure in any dimension strictly limits credit on the others. Each operator ships with specification, golden implementation, public test cases, and performance baseline. Built-in anti-reward-hacking detection identifies bypassed accuracy assertions, hard-coded shapes, and memorized outputs. The task set and evaluation protocol evolve with Ascend hardware, CANN releases, and new model families.
summary_en.experiments: Comparison with prior benchmarks shows KernelBench, TritonBench and similar only support NVIDIA platforms, with tiling semantics and buffer structure designs that do not transfer to Ascend. MultiKernelBench is cross-platform but has limited depth for Ascend tasks and narrow precision coverage. NPUKernelBench is tied to the specific AscendKernelGen training recipe, with static-shape tests that can be gamed by shape-specialized kernels. Companion method validation shows AscendKernelGen reaches 95.5% Pass@10 compilation rate on level-2 tasks (up from 0%), and AscendOptimizer achieves 1.19x geometric mean speedup across 127 cann-ops operators.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 1.2 (6 design criteria, core constraints of benchmark design), Section 2 (task tiering and 3-axis scoring rules), Table 1 (comparison with existing benchmarks). Estimated reading time 15-20 minutes. For code agent training use cases, refer to the appendix for test case specifications.

recommendation.zh: DPO 加可靠性加权是合理方向，对理解偏好数据质量与对齐效果的关系有参考，重点看可靠性估计的具体实现和消融。
recommendation.en: Reliability-weighted DPO is a sensible direction; useful for understanding how preference data quality affects alignment. Focus on the reliability estimation details and ablations.

paper.title: EvoThink: Evolving Thinking in Large Reasoning Models via Self-Pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking due to redundant verification steps. Existing approaches for mitigating overthinking, such as fast-slow thinking switching and reasoning trajectory compression, fail to make a fine-grained distinction between beneficial and redundant steps within the LRM's reasoning process, and may thus impair reasoning capability in their pursuit of efficiency. To simultaneously improve reasoning efficiency and capability, we propose EvoThink, a fram

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是大推理模型里的 overthinking：模型在已经得到有效推理路径后，仍继续做大量重复验证、回溯和改写，导致输出很长、推理成本高，而且这些额外 token 往往不提升正确率，甚至会引入噪声。论文进一步指出，现有两类做法都不够精细：fast/slow routing 是在推理前做粗粒度二选一，容易误判题目难度；trajectory compression 虽然能缩短链路，但常常把有用的验证步骤和冗余步骤一起压掉，结果是效率上去了，能力却掉了。作者想解决的是一个更细粒度的问题：能不能只删掉重复验证，同时保留甚至增强真正有帮助的推理结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如训练 recipe 或数据论文强，但它对 post-train 与推理行为塑形有现实意义，尤其是 reasoning model 的长度控制、训练信号设计和失败轨迹利用。重要之处有两点。第一，它把 overthinking 视为 reasoning quality 问题，而不只是 decoding 成本问题，因此优化目标不是单纯缩短输出，而是区分“有益验证”和“重复验证”。第二，它没有停在压缩层面，而是试图用失败轨迹里的 from-wrong-to-right 转折去补回甚至提升能力。这一点对后训练很有启发：错误样本不只是负例，也可以是构造高信息密度偏好数据的来源。量级上，这更像 reasoning post-training 方法，而不是基座预训练范式变化；但如果关心 RL/SFT 如何反向塑造模型的思维长度和探索模式，这篇值得看。
summary.technical_approach: EvoThink 分两阶段。第一阶段是 Self-Pruning Training，目标是去掉冗余验证。模型先对问题生成带 <think>...</think> 的完整推理轨迹和最终答案，然后系统识别 reasoning trajectory 里重复的自我验证、重复求解、对已确认结论的再次展开等片段，并把这些片段剪掉，得到更精炼的轨迹。之后再用这些 pruned trajectories 做 self-training，并且是迭代进行：第 i 轮模型生成，第 i 轮规则或机制剪枝，再训练得到第 i+1 轮模型。这里的关键不是简单按长度截断，而是试图在轨迹内部做结构化删减，所以作者把它称为 fine-grained pruning，而不是 compression。第二阶段是 Aha-Moment Preference Optimization，目标是补能力。作者从错误推理轨迹出发，把失败样本看成一个 population，用 fitness function 评估哪些失败“有潜力”，这里的潜力主要和推理多样性、探索价值有关，而不是只看错得多离谱。然后在这些高潜失败上构造所谓 aha-moment 数据：把错误推理路径与正确答案之间的转折显式组织出来，形成一种 from-wrong-to-right 的偏好对。最后用 DPO 训练模型，让模型偏好能走向新路径、完成关键转折的推理，而不是只学会更短地复述已有正确解。与已有方法相比，EvoThink 的区别在于两点：SPT 不是题目级别的 fast/slow 切换，而是轨迹级别删冗余；AMPO 不是只用正确答案监督，而是把高价值失败转成偏好学习信号，鼓励探索式修正。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理和代码生成上做了较系统的实验。引言里给出的一个核心观察是，原始 LRM 超过 65% 的 token 花在重复计算和重复验证上，这为 SPT 提供了动机。实验结论是 EvoThink 能同时改善效率和能力，而不是像很多压缩方法那样用准确率换长度。具体来说，SPT 单独使用时，能显著缩短 reasoning trace，并在多数任务上保持甚至略增性能；加入 AMPO 后，准确率进一步提升，说明从失败到修正的偏好学习确实补回了压缩可能带来的能力损失。论文还做了对比：只用正确解做优化，不如用 aha-moment 数据，因为后者更接近模型真实探索新路径的过程。消融重点通常包括 SPT 的迭代次数、pruning 策略、fitness function 设计，以及是否使用 AMPO。就当前给出的全文片段看，没有完整表格数字可逐项抄录，但主结论很清楚：EvoThink 不是单纯减少 token，而是在更短轨迹下维持或提升数学与代码任务表现。如果精读原文，建议重点核对主表里的长度下降比例、各 benchmark 的准确率变化，以及 AMPO 相对“correct-only preference”基线的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，对问题定义和两阶段框架建立直觉。然后看 Method 里 SPT 的 pruning 规则或判定机制，判断它到底是在做启发式删句，还是对推理结构有更明确的识别。第二个重点是 AMPO 的 fitness function 和 aha-moment 数据构造方式，这部分决定了它是不是只是另一种偏好数据拼接。实验部分优先看三类结果：长度与准确率的 trade-off、SPT/AMPO 消融、以及只用正确解监督与 aha-moment 监督的对比。预计 25 到 40 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 reasoning post-train，值得把附录里的数据构造细节也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets overthinking in large reasoning models: after reaching a useful line of reasoning, the model keeps generating repeated verification, re-derivations, and redundant checks. This inflates output length and inference cost, while often adding little or even hurting final accuracy. The authors argue that existing solutions are too coarse. Fast-vs-slow routing makes a pre-reasoning binary decision and can fail on misclassified problems. Trajectory compression shortens outputs, but often removes helpful verification together with redundant verification. The real problem, then, is not just shortening reasoning, but pruning the right parts.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training and reasoning-behavior paper than a core pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to base-model researchers interested in how training signals shape reasoning length and exploration. Two aspects matter. First, it treats overthinking as a reasoning-quality issue rather than a pure decoding-efficiency issue. Second, it uses failed trajectories as a source of useful supervision instead of discarding them. That is a meaningful idea for post-train pipelines: failure traces can be converted into high-information preference data, especially when the goal is to encourage productive exploration rather than mere brevity.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoThink has two stages. Stage one is Self-Pruning Training (SPT). The model first generates a full reasoning trace inside <think> tags plus a final answer. The method then identifies redundant self-verification patterns inside the trace, such as repeated checking of already established conclusions or repeated solution attempts that do not add new information. These parts are pruned, and the model is self-trained on the resulting concise trajectories. This process is iterative: a model at iteration i generates traces, those traces are pruned, and the pruned data is used to train the next model. The key point is that SPT is not simple length truncation; it aims at fine-grained removal of redundant reasoning segments. Stage two is Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (AMPO). Here the authors collect incorrect reasoning trajectories and treat them as a population of failures. A fitness function is used to select high-potential failures, with emphasis on diversity and exploratory value. From these, they construct aha-moment preference data that explicitly captures a transition from a wrong path to a correct resolution. DPO is then used to train the model to prefer such trajectories. Compared with prior work, the novelty is the combination of trajectory-level redundancy pruning and preference learning from curated wrong-to-right transitions, rather than only compressing outputs or training on correct solutions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and code generation. One motivating statistic from the paper is that more than 65% of tokens in baseline reasoning traces are spent on redundant computation or repeated verification. The main empirical claim is that EvoThink improves both efficiency and capability. SPT alone shortens reasoning traces substantially while largely preserving, and sometimes slightly improving, task performance. Adding AMPO further improves accuracy, suggesting that the wrong-to-right preference signal helps recover or exceed any capability lost during pruning. The paper also compares AMPO against optimization using only correct solutions and reports that aha-moment data is more effective, presumably because it better reflects the exploratory process of discovering a new reasoning path. The most important ablations are likely the number of SPT iterations, the pruning strategy, the fitness function for failure selection, and the effect of removing AMPO. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark-by-benchmark numbers are not recoverable here, but the qualitative result is clear: the method is not merely reducing tokens; it is trying to improve the length-quality trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand the problem framing and the two-stage pipeline. Then inspect the SPT section carefully: the main question is whether pruning is based on shallow heuristics or on a more structured notion of redundant reasoning. After that, read the AMPO section with attention to the fitness function and the construction of aha-moment pairs. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: accuracy versus output length, SPT and AMPO ablations, and AMPO versus correct-only optimization. A useful skim should take around 25 to 40 minutes. If you work on reasoning post-training, the appendix is likely worth reading for data-construction details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SPT 的 pruning 判据和 AMPO 数据构造；若无强 ablation，就当 reasoning SFT 配方备查。
recommendation.en: Read only the SPT pruning criterion and AMPO data construction; without strong ablations, treat it as a reasoning-SFT recipe note.

paper.title: S2T-RLHF: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Stable Preference-Based RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with preference-based reward models often exhibits unstable training dynamics. A key contributing factor is that standard RLHF relies on a single sequence-level scalar reward, which is propagated to token-level policy updates and leaves credit assignment within a response inherently ambiguous. Recent work has attempted to address this issue by refining rewards into denser token-level supervision, often relying on the implicit assumption that fine

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对 RLHF 里一个很核心但长期没有处理干净的问题：偏好奖励通常只在整段回答级别给一个标量，而策略更新发生在 token 级，导致 credit assignment 含糊、梯度方差大、训练不稳，尤其在长回答上更明显。作者进一步指出，问题不只是“奖励太稀疏”，而是“奖励粒度和语言语义结构不匹配”。如果把一个本来只在 response 级定义、且带噪声的偏好信号，强行细化到 token 级，未必更好，反而可能把 reward model 的局部误差放大，造成长度偏置、奖励集中和 collapse。论文要解决的，是如何在不重训 reward model、也没有 token 级标注的前提下，构造一种更稳定的层次化 credit assignment。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 主线来说，这不是预训练论文，但它和 pretrain↔posttrain 接口关系很紧。原因有三点。第一，RLHF 的稳定性会反过来影响人们如何理解 base model 的可塑性、长度泛化和 reward hacking 边界。第二，这篇工作提出的“奖励粒度要和语义粒度对齐”这个观点，不只适用于 RLHF，也会影响对 masked LM、diffusion LM、latent reasoning、过程监督等训练信号设计的理解。第三，它把 dense reward 设计从“越细越好”改成“在合适层级上细化”，这对未来把 RL 信号引入 continual pretrain、reasoning post-train、甚至 RL-style pretraining 都有启发。贡献量级上，它更像是对 RLHF credit assignment 设计原则的一次扎实修正，而不是单纯加一个 heuristic。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 S2T-RLHF，核心是两阶段层次化分配：先 sentence-level，再 token-level。作者的出发点很明确：句子通常是人类偏好判断更稳定的语义单元，token 只是句子内部的词法和句法实现。如果直接把 sequence reward 平摊或细分到 token，容易把本来模糊的全局偏好变成高噪声局部监督。因此他们先把整段回答切成句子级单元，在句子层面做结构化 cooperative allocation，再在每个句子内部做有界的 token-level refinement。

从全文描述看，S2T-RLHF 保持 reward model 固定，只使用 sequence-level reward。第一阶段的句子级分配，目标是把全局偏好信号分解到语义上相对完整、可解释的句子单元，而不是任意 token span。这里“structured cooperative allocation”意味着句子不是独立打分，而是作为共同组成整段回答的协作单元来分配总奖励，避免把全局偏好简单地局部化。第二阶段的 token refinement 则是 bounded 的，也就是 token 级修正幅度受控，不允许 token 级信号偏离句子级语义太远。这个约束很关键，因为作者的核心论点就是：过细粒度会放大噪声，所以 token 级只能做局部微调，不能主导奖励结构。

论文还在附录里给出理论讨论，主要围绕三件事：sequence-level reward 如何诱导全局 advantage alignment；长序列上方差如何放大；以及长度依赖的梯度缩放问题。S2T 的两阶段设计对应地缓解了这三类问题：句子级分配缩短了 credit propagation 路径，降低长程方差；token 级 bounded refinement 保留一定局部可塑性，但不至于把噪声扩散到每个 token；层次化结构也更容易抑制长度偏置，因为奖励不再简单按 token 数量传播。

和已有 dense reward / token-level credit 方法相比，差别不在于“更细”，而在于“先在合适语义层级上聚合，再有限地下钻”。这和很多 RLHF 工作默认 finer-grained is better 的思路相反，也是这篇论文最值得注意的地方。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主结论是：S2T-RLHF 在多个数据集和优化设置下，提高了训练稳定性和鲁棒性，同时保持有竞争力的偏好对齐效果。全文片段没有给出完整表格数字，因此不能编造具体提升幅度，但从引言和方法描述可以明确，作者重点比较了标准 sequence-level RLHF、若干更细粒度的 credit assignment 基线，以及自己的层次化方法。

应重点关注的实验信号包括：1）训练曲线是否更平稳，是否减少 reward collapse 或剧烈震荡；2）长度分布是否更健康，是否缓解了长回答被过度奖励或惩罚的问题；3）在不同 PPO/DPO 类优化设定或不同 preference dataset 上，方法是否保持一致收益；4）句子级分配和 token-level bounded refinement 各自的消融作用。按论文主张，最关键的消融应该是：只做句子级、不做 token refinement；直接 token-level refinement；以及不同 refinement 强度上限。若这些实验成立，就能支持作者的核心判断：稳定性来自语义粒度匹配，而不是单纯增加监督密度。

如果精读全文，建议特别查具体实验设置：基座模型规模、reward model 是否统一、回答平均长度、句子切分方式、以及训练中 KL 系数和 advantage normalization 的处理。因为这类方法的收益往往和序列长度、奖励噪声、以及 policy update 强度强相关。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然被标成 skim，但如果你关心 RLHF 稳定性，值得比普通 skim 多花一点时间。建议先读 Introduction，把作者反对“越细粒度越好”的论证读明白。然后直接看 Method，重点抓住两阶段设计各自解决什么问题：为什么先句子后 token；为什么 token refinement 必须 bounded；它和 reward shaping 或 token-level RM 有什么不同。实验部分优先看训练稳定性曲线、长度相关分析、主结果表和消融。附录里关于 variance amplification 和 length-dependent gradient scaling 的理论讨论也值得扫一遍，因为它解释了为什么长回答 RLHF 特别容易出问题。预计 45-60 分钟可以读完主线；如果要判断是否可用于自己的训练栈，消融和附录需要再多看一轮。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a central RLHF issue: preference rewards are usually defined at the whole-response level, while policy optimization happens at the token level. That creates ambiguous credit assignment, high-variance gradients, and unstable learning, especially for long generations. The authors make a sharper claim than the usual “reward is too sparse” diagnosis. Their argument is that the granularity of the reward signal is mismatched with the semantic structure of language. If a noisy response-level preference is aggressively refined into token-level supervision, the refinement can amplify uncertainty and local reward-model artifacts instead of improving optimization. The problem, then, is how to derive denser but more stable credit signals without retraining the reward model or requiring token-level annotations.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it speaks directly to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Stable RLHF changes how we think about model plasticity, long-horizon optimization, and reward hacking. More importantly, the paper proposes a useful design principle: reward granularity should align with semantic granularity. That idea extends beyond RLHF and is relevant to process supervision, latent reasoning, non-AR objectives, and any setting where training signals are projected onto finer units than the original supervision naturally supports. The contribution is less about adding another heuristic and more about correcting a common assumption in dense reward design: finer is not always better.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, S2T-RLHF, uses a two-stage hierarchical credit assignment scheme: sentence level first, token level second. The motivation is simple and well argued. Human preferences are often expressed over semantically coherent units such as claims, instructions, refusals, or stylistic choices, and sentences are a much better proxy for those units than individual tokens. Tokens mostly realize sentence meaning through lexical and syntactic choices. So instead of directly decomposing a sequence-level reward into token-level rewards, the method first allocates reward across sentence-level units and only then performs bounded token-level refinement within each sentence.

A key design choice is that the reward model remains fixed and only sequence-level preference rewards are used. In the first stage, the global reward is distributed over sentence units through a structured cooperative allocation mechanism. The wording suggests that sentences are treated as jointly contributing parts of the response, rather than independently scored fragments. That matters because a response-level preference often depends on interactions across sentences, not just local quality. In the second stage, token-level refinement is explicitly bounded. This is crucial: the paper’s main thesis is that unconstrained fine-grained refinement can inject instability, so token-level signals are allowed only as local adjustments around a sentence-level semantic anchor.

The appendices reportedly provide theoretical discussion around three issues: how sequence-level rewards induce global advantage alignment, how variance amplifies over long horizons, and how gradients scale with response length. The S2T design addresses these by shortening the effective credit-assignment path through sentence-level decomposition, while preserving limited local flexibility through bounded token refinement. Compared with prior dense-reward or token-level credit methods, the novelty is not “more granularity” but “the right granularity first, then controlled refinement.”
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is that S2T-RLHF improves training stability and robustness across multiple datasets and optimization settings while maintaining competitive preference alignment performance. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. Still, the experimental intent is clear: compare standard sequence-level RLHF, finer-grained credit-assignment baselines, and the proposed hierarchical method.

The most important signals to inspect are: whether training curves are smoother; whether reward collapse or severe oscillation is reduced; whether response-length behavior becomes healthier; whether the method remains effective across different optimization setups; and whether the gains come specifically from the sentence-first hierarchy rather than from simply adding denser supervision. The critical ablations should include sentence-level allocation alone, direct token-level refinement, and different bounds on token refinement strength. If those ablations are convincing, they support the paper’s central claim that stability comes from semantic alignment of reward granularity, not from maximizing reward density.
summary_en.reading_guide: Although labeled skim, this one deserves more attention if RLHF stability is part of your work. Start with the introduction and make sure the paper’s argument against “finer is always better” is clear. Then read the method section with two questions in mind: why sentence-level units are the right intermediate granularity, and why token-level refinement must be bounded. In the experiments, prioritize training-stability plots, length-related analyses, the main comparison table, and the ablations. The appendix discussion on variance amplification and length-dependent gradient scaling is also worth scanning because it explains why long-form RLHF is particularly fragile. Around 45–60 minutes should be enough for the main thread; more time is needed if you want to judge whether the method would transfer to your own RLHF stack.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法动机和稳定性实验；若结果扎实，应复现“句子粒度优于 token 粒度”这个 RLHF 信号设计 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the motivation and stability ablations; if the evidence is clean, the sentence-level-over-token-level credit prior is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: When Physical Preferences Meet Semantic Constraints: Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have achieved strong visual realism, but improving physical plausibility can come at the cost of semantic consistency with the input text. This tension arises because physical preference is typically determined by comparing dynamics between two videos, without accounting for whether either video faithfully depicts the scene specified by the prompt, making physical-semantic conflict a systematic tendency under this supervision paradigm. We formulate this chal

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到视频生成中“物理合理性偏好优化”容易破坏文本语义一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成后训练中的偏好目标修正：把物理偏好和语义约束放进同一个优化问题，并分析冲突偏好对语义漂移的梯度影响。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization，把每个偏好样本对的训练权重或贡献按物理信号与语义信号的一致程度进行调制；通过梯度级分析证明冲突样本导致的语义漂移可被限制到可控残差，并设计分阶段优化流程降低累计漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体 T2V 基座模型、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和提升幅度；只说明方法完全在偏好优化框架内工作，用于改善物理 plausibility 与 prompt semantic consistency 的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off in text-to-video generation where optimizing for physical plausibility can degrade semantic consistency with the input prompt.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization objective for multimodal generation: it treats physical preference learning as constrained by semantic agreement and analyzes gradient-level semantic drift from conflicting pairs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization, which modulates the contribution of each preference pair according to the agreement between its physical and semantic signals. A gradient analysis motivates a staged optimization protocol that bounds and reduces cumulative semantic drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact T2V backbone, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It reports the method as a preference-optimization approach for improving the balance between physical plausibility and prompt faithfulness.

recommendation.zh: 看作视频生成版 DPO 目标设计案例即可；理论边界可能依赖打分器质量，预训练侧不必深读。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a T2V preference-objective design case; the bounds likely depend on scorer quality, so it is not a deep pretraining read.

paper.title: RIMS: Preference Optimization via Smoothed Multi-pair Aggregation for Small-Scale LLM Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Small-scale language models (SLMs) are attractive for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in resource-constrained settings, but their limited capacity makes them highly sensitive to noisy or spurious retrieved evidence. Existing preference-based methods such as RoseRAG select only the hardest single preference pair via hard argmin/argmax, discarding the remaining signal; others treat multiple pairs as independent binary comparisons, resulting in low data utilization. We propose RIMS, a three-st

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型在 RAG 场景中对噪声检索证据敏感，以及现有偏好优化方法只使用单个 hard preference pair 或把多 pair 独立处理导致训练信号利用不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向 RAG 的后训练目标改进。它不直接推进预训练，但涉及偏好数据构造、拒绝采样和多比较信号聚合，对理解小模型如何利用弱偏好信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RIMS 三阶段框架：先用目标小模型自身通过拒绝采样生成合成 CoT 偏好数据，不依赖闭源教师；再用可微的 soft aggregation 替代 hard argmin/argmax，从多个 preference pairs 中保留梯度；最后用平滑后的多 pair preference objective 做优化。方法主要是对 RAG 偏好优化目标和数据利用方式的改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、RAG 数据集、baseline 名称、指标或提升幅度。需要看正文确认是否只在小规模 RAG benchmark 上有效，以及 self-generated CoT preference 是否引入确认偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets small-scale LMs for RAG, where noisy or spurious retrieved evidence can dominate, and existing preference optimization methods waste signal by selecting a single hard pair or treating many pairs as independent binaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training objective contribution for RAG. It is not central to base pretraining, but the treatment of synthetic preference data and multi-pair aggregation is mildly useful for understanding how small models can learn from weak preference signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: RIMS uses a three-stage pipeline: generating synthetic chain-of-thought preference data with rejection sampling from the target SLM itself, replacing hard pair selection with a differentiable soft aggregation operator, and optimizing a smoothed multi-pair preference objective. The novelty is mainly in the preference loss and data-utilization strategy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, RAG datasets, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The full paper should be checked for whether the method holds beyond small RAG benchmarks and whether self-generated CoT preferences create self-confirmation bias.

recommendation.zh: 作为小模型 RAG 偏好优化备查即可；关键看 soft aggregation 是否比多 pair DPO 有干净增益。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for small-model RAG preference tuning; the only real question is whether soft aggregation beats multi-pair DPO in a clean setup.

paper.title: MeanFlowNFT: Bringing Forward-Process RL to Average-Velocity Generators
paper.abstract: MeanFlow generators achieve fast few-step sampling by predicting average velocities over time intervals, making them attractive for efficient generation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful way to align diffusion and flow models with human preferences and task-specific objectives. In particular, DiffusionNFT offers an efficient forward-process RL framework that does not require reverse-process trajectories or likelihood estimation. However, applying such RL methods to MeanFlow rema

summary.core_problem: MeanFlow 生成器用平均速度实现少步采样，但现有 forward-process RL 主要针对瞬时速度，不能直接用于 MeanFlow 的 reward optimization。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型后训练方法的适配：把 DiffusionNFT 这类不依赖反向轨迹或似然估计的 RL 框架迁移到 MeanFlow。对图像/视频生成模型对齐有用，对文本 LLM 预训练只有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: MeanFlowNFT 利用 MeanFlow identity，在平均速度预测器上构造 induced instantaneous-velocity predictor，并在该瞬时速度预测器上施加 DiffusionNFT objective。采样阶段仍使用平均速度，以保留 MeanFlow 的少步生成效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务、模型规模、reward 类型、baseline、采样步数或量化提升，只说明目标是在不牺牲 MeanFlow 快速少步采样的前提下实现 reward optimization。

summary_en.core_problem: MeanFlow generators sample efficiently with average velocities, but existing forward-process RL methods are formulated for instantaneous velocities and do not directly fit MeanFlow.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an adaptation of generative-model post-training: it transfers DiffusionNFT-style reward optimization, which avoids reverse trajectories and likelihood estimation, to MeanFlow. It is useful for aligned image/video generators and only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MeanFlowNFT uses the MeanFlow identity to derive an induced instantaneous-velocity predictor from the average-velocity generator, applies the DiffusionNFT objective to that predictor, and keeps sampling with average velocities to preserve few-step generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report tasks, model sizes, reward models, baselines, sampling steps, or numerical gains. It frames the result as reward optimization while maintaining MeanFlow's fast sampling path.

recommendation.zh: 作为生成模型 RL 适配案例备查；核心看 induced instantaneous velocity 的推导，别把结论外推到文本 LM。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a generative-model RL reference; read the induced instantaneous-velocity derivation, but do not over-transfer the result to text LMs.

paper.title: Improving Text-to-Audio Instruction Following via Fine-Grained Feedback from Audio-Aware Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent text-to-audio models generate high-quality audio, but often fail to follow instructions involving multiple sound events and temporal order. This gap arises because existing evaluation and training signals mainly emphasize global similarity or perceptual quality, with limited supervision on instruction-level correctness. We propose an instruction-level framework that uses audio-aware large language models (ALLMs) as fine-grained judges to verify target event presence and temporal relations

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到音频生成模型在多事件、时间顺序、叙事式指令上不稳定遵循的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把 audio-aware LLM 作为细粒度评审器，为音频生成提供事件存在性和时间关系层面的训练信号；这比只优化全局相似度或感知质量更接近指令跟随。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先验证音频感知大模型对生成音频中目标事件和时间关系的判断可靠性，再用这些判断构造偏好对，并通过 DPO 优化文本到音频模型。论文还提出 S3Bench，用叙事式多事件指令评估 temporal instruction following。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖已有文本到音频评测集和新提出的 S3Bench，报告在事件完整性、时间排序、联合指令遵循准确率上提升，同时保持音频感知质量。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National Taiwan University 和 Amazon；Hung-yi Lee 是语音与语言建模方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses weak instruction following in text-to-audio generation, especially for prompts involving multiple sound events and temporal ordering.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is to use audio-aware LLMs as fine-grained judges that produce event-level and relation-level training signals, rather than relying only on global similarity or perceptual audio quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method validates audio-aware LLM judgments against benchmarks and human checks, uses those judgments to build preference pairs, and applies DPO to improve text-to-audio instruction following. It also introduces S3Bench for narrative multi-event temporal evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on existing text-to-audio benchmarks and S3Bench, improving event completeness, temporal ordering, and joint instruction-following accuracy while preserving audio quality. The abstract does not specify model size, data scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from National Taiwan University and Amazon; Hung-yi Lee is a well-known researcher in speech and language modeling.

summary.importance: 贡献类型是扩散生成采样器的偏好优化方法。它把 DPO 思路迁移到 diffusion sampler，对多模态生成和 preference-based optimization 有参考价值，但不是文本 Diffusion LM 或 LLM 预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 D2PO，即 Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization。方法把采样策略建模为 energy-based model，将偏好比较转化为能量差；同时从预训练 score network 直接构造能量形式，使偏好信号可以用于 timestep 与 CFG 动态策略优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露使用的数据集、基础 diffusion 模型、NFE 设置、评价指标或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 是 student-teacher regression 低 NFE sampler，以及高 NFE teacher 模仿范式。
summary.authors_note: Bohyung Han 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；输入元数据未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper optimizes low-NFE diffusion samplers over timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance weights, targeting the texture loss caused by teacher-regression distillation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for diffusion generation. It is relevant to multimodal generation and preference-based training, but it is not a text diffusion LM or LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: D2PO, or Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization, reformulates sampler optimization as preference alignment. It models the sampling policy as an energy-based model, turns preference comparisons into energy differences, and derives an energy formulation directly from the pretrained score network.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, base diffusion models, NFE budgets, metrics, or quantitative improvements. The stated baseline is the common student-teacher regression setup for low-NFE samplers that imitates high-NFE teachers.
summary_en.authors_note: Bohyung Han is a well-known computer vision researcher; affiliation details are not provided in the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 偏好优化迁移到 sampler 的角度可备查；若关心 LLM pretrain，只看 EBM-DPO 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for moving preference optimization into samplers; for LLM pretraining, only the EBM-DPO derivation is worth a look.

Since LLMs still struggle to effectively manage large tool collections, researchers have begun exploring retrieval-based methods to pre-select the most relevant options, addressing input length and latency constraints. However, existing retrievers are often misaligned with tool-calling LLMs due to their separate training processes. This paper presents PORTS, a novel o

summary.core_problem: 面向LLM工具选择的检索器因与LLM分开训练，存在与下游工具调用任务不对齐的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，将偏好优化思路引入检索器训练，提出用冻结LLM的偏好信号训练工具选择检索器
summary.technical_approach: 提出PORTS方法，使用冻结LLM的困惑度偏好信号，通过odds ratio偏好优化训练检索器，同时加入文档字符串的对比语义损失约束
summary.experiments: 在多个工具选择基准上验证了方法有效性，显著提升了工具选择准确率
summary.authors_note: 作者来自意大利大学研究团队，无知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Retrievers for LLM tool selection are misaligned with downstream tool-calling tasks due to separate training processes
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; introduces preference optimization to retriever training, using frozen LLM preference signals for tool selection retrievers
summary_en.technical_approach: PORTS method that uses perplexity-inspired preference signals from a frozen LLM to train a retriever via odds ratio preference optimization, with a contrastive semantic loss between documentation strings
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates significant improvements in tool selection accuracy across multiple tool selection benchmarks
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Italian university research groups; no prominent LLM researchers

recommendation.zh: 工具选择检索器的偏好优化小改进，属于Agent领域增量工作，对预训练研究员参考价值有限
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in preference-optimized retrievers for tool selection; limited value for pretraining researchers

paper.title: Multi-Objective Exploration and Preference Optimization via Mutual Information
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models with diverse and heterogeneous human values requires multi-objective alignment methods to effectively trade off conflicting preference dimensions. Current methods achieve this trade-off by training policies conditioned on preference vectors and leveraging online direct preference optimization. However, exploration uncertainty can cause the reward distributions of responses generated under different preference vectors to overlap, and the generated responses may fail

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多目标对齐中的条件控制失效问题。现有 MO-ODPO 类方法用偏好向量控制生成，希望模型在 helpfulness、harmlessness 等目标之间做可调权衡。但在线采样带来的探索噪声会让不同偏好条件下的回答奖励分布高度重叠，同一个偏好向量下的输出也有较大波动。结果是偏好向量虽然作为条件输入存在，生成结果却没有稳定反映这个条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏 post-train / alignment。但它有一个可借鉴的点：把“探索”和“条件可控性”统一到互信息目标里，而不是只靠偏好损失推动策略更新。对于多目标 RLHF、可控生成、pretrain-posttrain 接口中的条件信号质量分析，这个视角有参考意义。它提醒一个实际问题：条件向量进入模型并不等于模型真正使用了条件，训练目标需要显式奖励不同条件下输出分布的可区分性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 MI-EPO。核心目标是最大化联合条件互信息 I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X)，其中 X 是 prompt，Y 是 response，W 是偏好向量，Z 是概率路由变量，用来选择当前关注的目标维度，C_Z 是该目标下的反馈信号。作者用互信息链式分解，把目标拆成两部分：I(Y; C_Z | X, W, Z) 负责目标特定的偏好对齐，类似让输出和被选中目标的反馈更一致；I(Y; W | X) 负责偏好感知探索，鼓励不同偏好向量对应的输出在分布上可区分。和普通 MO-ODPO 的区别在于，后者主要优化偏好排序信号，默认条件控制会通过 DPO 学出来；MI-EPO 则显式加入 response 与 preference vector 的互信息项，减少不同偏好条件下输出同质化的问题。论文还使用 InfoNCE 形式给条件互信息构造可优化下界，使目标可以并入标准偏好优化训练。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文片段看，实验重点是比较 MI-EPO 与 MO-ODPO 等多目标在线偏好优化方法。作者报告的主要现象是：MO-ODPO 在相同偏好条件下 reward 波动较大，不同偏好条件下 reward 分布有明显重叠；MI-EPO 通过互信息项让不同偏好向量下的响应分布更分离，条件控制更稳定。片段中没有给出完整数据集、模型规模、训练步数和具体数值表，因此不宜补充未出现的数字。更可靠的实验结论是：互信息正则主要改善 preference-response alignment 和 preference-conditioned exploration，而不是单纯提高某个单目标 reward。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 MO-ODPO reward overlap 的诊断，以及方法部分对 I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X) 的分解。Preliminary 中 DPO 和 CMI / InfoNCE 的推导只需确认目标如何落到可训练损失上。实验部分建议重点看两个问题：不同偏好向量下输出分布是否真的更可分；互信息项是否带来 trade-off 曲线的改善，而不是只改变 reward 尺度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a control failure in multi-objective alignment. Recent MO-ODPO-style methods condition the policy on preference vectors, expecting the model to trade off dimensions such as helpfulness and harmlessness. In practice, online exploration introduces uncertainty: reward distributions under different preference vectors overlap, and responses sampled under the same preference condition fluctuate substantially. The conditioning signal is present in the input, but the generated response does not reliably reflect it.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training and alignment rather than base pretraining. Its useful contribution is the information-theoretic framing: exploration and conditional controllability are optimized jointly through mutual information, instead of relying only on a preference-ranking loss. This is relevant for multi-objective RLHF, controllable generation, and the pretrain-posttrain interface, especially when analyzing whether a model actually uses conditioning signals. The main lesson is practical: adding a preference vector to the prompt or input representation does not guarantee conditional control; the objective may need to explicitly reward distinguishability across conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: MI-EPO maximizes the joint conditional mutual information I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X), where X is the prompt, Y is the response, W is the preference vector, Z is a probabilistic routing variable selecting an objective dimension, and C_Z is the feedback for that selected objective. The objective is decomposed into two complementary terms. I(Y; C_Z | X, W, Z) drives objective-specific preference alignment. I(Y; W | X) encourages preference-aware exploration, making responses generated under different preference vectors more distinguishable. Compared with standard MO-ODPO, which mainly optimizes pairwise preference signals and assumes the conditional policy will learn to use W, MI-EPO directly regularizes the dependence between responses and preference vectors. The paper uses an InfoNCE-style lower bound to make the conditional mutual information objective trainable within a preference-optimization pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the available full-content excerpt, the experiments focus on comparing MI-EPO with MO-ODPO and related multi-objective online preference optimization baselines. The key observed failure mode for MO-ODPO is large reward variance under the same preference condition and significant overlap between reward distributions under different conditions. MI-EPO is reported to make the response distributions more separable across preference vectors and to improve preference-response alignment. The excerpt does not provide full tables, model sizes, datasets, or exact numerical gains, so those details should not be inferred. The robust takeaway is that the mutual-information term improves conditional control and exploration quality, rather than merely increasing a scalar reward.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the diagnostic in the Introduction, especially Figure 1 and the reward-overlap argument, then read the derivation of I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X) and its decomposition. The DPO and CMI / InfoNCE preliminaries are useful only insofar as they explain how the objective becomes a trainable loss. In the experiments, check whether the method truly separates outputs across preference vectors and whether the trade-off behavior improves, rather than only shifting reward scales.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；若 routing 真能降低目标混淆，内部多目标 DPO/RLVR 数据配方应复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; if routing really reduces objective confusion, it should be reproduced in internal multi-objective DPO/RLVR recipes.

paper.title: Distributionally Robust Listwise Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Existing robust preference optimization for language-model alignment mainly studies pairwise supervision and places robustness at the dataset, prompt, or preference-pair level. We instead study listwise preference optimization under ranking-label uncertainty: given a prompt and a candidate list, the observed ranking over that list may be ambiguous due to annotator inconsistency, near-ties, lossy rankwise feedback, or reward-model noise. We propose a pointwise total-variation robust Plackett--Luc

summary.core_problem: 现有鲁棒偏好优化方法主要针对pairwise标注设计，未解决listwise排序中标注不一致、近似平局、奖励模型噪声带来的优化偏移问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出可扩展的鲁棒listwise偏好优化目标，具备理论优化保证
summary.technical_approach: 提出逐点全变分鲁棒Plackett-Luce目标，可分解为原始PL损失加最坏情况PL修正项；最坏情况排序可通过对当前隐式分数做升序排列得到，将内层最大化的复杂度从O(K!)降至O(K log K)
summary.experiments: 在离线固定列表设置下，鲁棒目标性能优于现有listwise偏好优化基线，同时具备离线和在线优化的理论收敛保证

summary_en.core_problem: Existing robust preference optimization methods focus on pairwise supervision, failing to address optimization bias from ranking ambiguity caused by annotator inconsistency, near-ties, and reward model noise in listwise settings
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: a tractable robust listwise preference optimization objective with formal optimization guarantees
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a pointwise total-variation robust Plackett-Luce objective that decomposes into nominal PL loss plus worst-case PL correction; the worst-case ranking is obtained by sorting current implicit scores in ascending order, reducing inner maximization complexity from O(K!) to O(K log K)
summary_en.experiments: In the offline fixed-list setting, the robust objective outperforms existing listwise preference optimization baselines, with provable offline and online optimization guarantees

recommendation.zh: 鲁棒listwise对齐的增量工作，把内层优化复杂度从阶乘降到对数线性，作为对齐方向文献备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental work on robust listwise alignment that reduces inner optimization complexity from factorial to log-linear; keep as reference for alignment literature, no deep read needed

paper.title: CAT: Confidence-Adaptive Thinking for Efficient Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by leveraging long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories, yet they frequently exhibit overthinking on simple queries, resulting in significant token overhead and reduced inference efficiency. However, existing compression methods predominantly apply uniform length reduction or rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, often leading to performance degradation on difficult problems. To address this limitation, we pro

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型在简单问题上常出现过长 CoT，导致推理 token 浪费；作者试图让模型按题目难度自适应地控制思考长度。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段的推理长度控制方法，不是预训练论文。它对 test-time compute allocation 和偏好优化信号设计有一定启发，尤其适合关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的人看。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Confidence-Adaptive Thinking（CAT），把模型自身的 self-certainty 信号转成 confidence，并纳入 preference optimization，使模型在高置信简单题上压缩思考长度，在低置信难题上保留更长推理。相较统一压缩或粗粒度难度估计，方法强调样本级自适应。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark、多个 base model 上，CAT 在推理准确率和 token 效率上都优于现有基线。对比对象包括统一长度压缩和基于粗难度估计的方法，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据来源和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自电子科技大学及四川省相关重点实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Large reasoning models often overthink on easy problems, wasting tokens; the paper aims to adapt reasoning length to problem difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method rather than a pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from test-time compute allocation and how preference optimization can shape reasoning behavior, which may matter at the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Confidence-Adaptive Thinking (CAT), which converts the model’s own self-certainty signals into confidence and injects them into preference optimization. The goal is to shorten reasoning on high-confidence easy cases while preserving longer deliberation on harder ones, instead of applying uniform compression.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, CAT consistently outperforms prior baselines on reasoning accuracy across multiple benchmarks and base models, while improving efficiency. Baselines include uniform length reduction and coarse-grained difficulty estimation methods, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and a Sichuan provincial key laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 典型 post-train 小改法，别把它当范式突破；若你关心 test-time compute 分配，只看 confidence 信号如何进 preference optimization，先怀疑自置信是否校准。
recommendation.en: This looks like a post-training tweak, not a paradigm shift; if you care about test-time compute allocation, inspect how confidence enters preference optimization and be skeptical about calibration.
