We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignm

summary.core_problem: 重新审视 DPO 与 RLHF 的理论等价性，指出该等价依赖一个实践中可能被破坏的隐含假设。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是对齐目标的理论分析与方法修正。它挑战了“DPO 是 RLHF 简化等价形式”的常见理解，并给出 DPO 可能降低 loss 却偏向人类不喜欢响应的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者证明 DPO-RLHF 等价不是无条件成立，而要求 RLHF 最优策略必须偏好人类偏好的回答；当该假设失败时，DPO 优化的是相对 reference policy 的 advantage，而不是相对人类偏好的绝对对齐。论文进一步刻画不良解空间，给出几何解释，并提出 Constrained Preference Optimization，在 RLHF 中加入约束以获得可证明对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 或具体数值。可确认内容以理论证明、失败模式构造、几何解释和 CPO 的可证明性质为主，可能包含验证 DPO 病态收敛的实验但摘要未列数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits the claimed equivalence between DPO and RLHF and identifies an implicit assumption that can fail in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical analysis and objective-level correction for alignment training. It challenges the common view that DPO is a universally equivalent simplification of RLHF and exposes cases where DPO loss can decrease while the policy prefers dispreferred responses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors prove that DPO-RLHF equivalence is conditional: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this condition fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences. They characterize the undesirable solution space, provide a geometric interpretation, and introduce Constrained Preference Optimization by adding constraints to RLHF for provable alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical results. The reported contribution is mainly theoretical, including proofs, failure-mode characterization, geometric analysis, and the proposed CPO objective.

recommendation.zh: 必须看定理条件和失败构造；它会修正“DPO≈RLHF”的默认 prior，尤其影响偏好数据噪声下的目标选择。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem conditions and failure construction; it revises the default “DPO≈RLHF” prior, especially for objective choice under noisy preference data.

paper.title: Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization for Flow Models
paper.abstract: Recent advancements have established Reinforcement Learning (RL) as a pivotal paradigm for aligning generative models with human intent. However, group-based optimization frameworks (e.g., GRPO) face a critical limitation: the rapid decay of intra-group variance. As the distinctiveness among samples within a group diminishes, the variance approaches zero. This eliminates the very learning signal required for optimization, rendering the process unstable and forcing the policy into premature stagn

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 flow / diffusion 模型偏好优化中的组内方差坍缩问题。GRPO 类方法依赖同一组样本之间的相对奖励差异来估计优势；训练后期样本越来越相似，组内差异变小，学习信号随之消失，进而导致停滞或 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 论文属于生成模型 post-training / alignment，但对预训练研究也有参考意义。它指出组相对优化的核心瓶颈不只是 reward model 质量，也包括探索分布是否还能维持有效差异。这个问题在 diffusion / flow 模型里通过采样轨迹表现出来，在 LLM 的 GRPO/RL 训练中也有相似风险：如果一组候选答案过早同质化，相对优势会变得不稳定。方法的启发是，与其单纯增加 group size 或初始噪声，不如在条件空间中构造受控、可学习的探索方向。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 E2PO，即 Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization。核心做法是在文本 embedding 空间注入一组学习到的结构化扰动条件，让同一 prompt 下的组内样本沿不同语义路径生成。这样可以主动维持组内可区分性，避免相对优势估计因为方差过小而退化。相比增加并行 SDE 轨迹，这种做法不只是扩大样本数；相比使用不同初始噪声，它把探索放在条件语义空间中，试图减少无意义噪声带来的视觉伪影和奖励投机。论文还把 flow matching、Rectified Flow 和 DiffusionNFT 式 forward-process 优化作为基础，目标是在不把整个采样过程完全形式化为复杂 MDP 的情况下进行偏好优化。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多组实验中同时提升了 alignment score 和生成多样性，并且训练轨迹比已有方法更稳定。关键实验应包括与 GRPO 类视觉偏好优化、DiffusionNFT、增加 group size、改变初始噪声等策略的比较；消融重点是 embedding perturbation 是否能维持组内方差、是否缓解 reward hacking、是否保留生成质量和多样性。给定材料没有提供具体模型规模、数据规模、奖励模型、benchmark 名称或数值提升，因此不应仅凭摘要判断效果量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对组内方差坍缩的诊断和 Figure 1；然后看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何把 Rectified Flow、SDE 采样和 DiffusionNFT 的 forward-process 优化连接起来。Method 部分应关注扰动 embedding 是固定、可学习还是按组生成，以及扰动如何进入目标函数。实验部分建议只细看方差曲线、reward hacking 案例、diversity 指标和扰动消融；如果没有这些证据，方法说服力会明显下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in preference optimization for flow and diffusion models. Group-relative methods rely on reward differences within a group of samples. As training progresses, samples within the same group become too similar, the intra-group variance shrinks, and the relative learning signal either vanishes or becomes unstable. This can lead to premature stagnation or reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about post-training generative models, but it is relevant to pretraining and alignment researchers because it isolates a concrete weakness of group-based RL objectives. The issue is not only reward quality; the exploration distribution must preserve meaningful differences among candidates. A similar concern exists in LLM GRPO-style training when candidate responses become homogeneous. The useful idea is to create controlled exploration in the conditioning space instead of only increasing group size or injecting more random noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, E2PO, injects learned and structured perturbations into the text embedding space. For the same prompt, different perturbed embeddings induce different semantic generation paths, which keeps samples within a group distinguishable. This is meant to maintain a non-degenerate relative advantage signal during optimization. Compared with larger groups, the method changes the exploration geometry rather than only adding samples. Compared with varying initial noise, it encourages diversity through the semantic condition, which may reduce incoherent artifacts and reward exploitation. The formulation builds on flow matching and Rectified Flow, and discusses forward-process optimization in the style of DiffusionNFT to avoid fully differentiating through a complex denoising MDP.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that E2PO improves alignment scores and generation diversity while producing a more stable optimization trajectory than prior baselines. The important evidence should be comparisons against visual GRPO-style optimization, DiffusionNFT-like objectives, larger group sizes, and different-noise exploration. The key ablations are whether embedding perturbations preserve intra-group variance, reduce reward hacking, and maintain image fidelity. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, datasets, reward models, benchmark names, or numerical gains, so the magnitude of the empirical improvement cannot be verified from the supplied material.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is appropriate, around 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the diagnosis of intra-group variance collapse and Figure 1 for the training failure mode. Then check the preliminaries to see how Rectified Flow, SDE sampling, and DiffusionNFT-style forward optimization are connected. In the method section, focus on how the embedding perturbations are parameterized, whether they are learned or sampled, and how they enter the optimization objective. In the experiments, prioritize variance curves, reward hacking examples, diversity metrics, and perturbation ablations.

recommendation.zh: RL对齐中的组内方差衰减是实际训练中会遇到的问题，E²PO从embedding扰动角度提供了一个思路，对RLHF/RLVR训练有参考价值
recommendation.en: Intra-group variance decay in RL alignment is a real training issue; E²PO's embedding perturbation approach is worth examining for RLHF/RLVR practice

paper.title: Pareto-Guided Optimal Transport for Multi-Reward Alignment
paper.abstract: Text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable progress in preference optimization, yet achieving robust alignment across diverse reward models remains a significant challenge. Existing multi-reward fusion approaches rely on weighted summation, which is costly to tune and insufficient for balancing conflicting objectives. More critically, optimization with reward models is highly susceptible to reward hacking, where reward scores increase while the perceived quality of generated images

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论多 reward 对齐中的 reward hacking：在文本生成图像模型的偏好优化里，不同 prompt 对应的图像域有不同 reward 上界，但现有方法常用统一全局目标或加权求和目标，容易让部分样本沿着 reward model 的漏洞优化，分数升高而人类感知质量下降。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与训练信号质量有参考价值。它把 reward hacking 的原因从“reward model 不够好”进一步拆到“不同样本的可达 reward 边界不同”。这个视角也适用于 LLM 的 RLHF、RLAIF 和多目标偏好优化：如果不同任务、语言、难度区间的 reward 分布和上界不同，用同一个全局 margin、baseline 或目标值，会把一部分样本推向不可靠区域。贡献主要在目标构造和评估指标，而不是模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Pareto Frontier-Guided Optimal Transport，简称 PG-OT。核心做法不是把多个 reward 线性加权成一个标量后统一最大化，而是为每个 prompt 构造 prompt-specific Pareto frontier。生成样本 batch 被视为源分布，Pareto frontier 被视为目标分布，然后用 optimal transport 将样本分布映射到对应 frontier。这样做的动机是尊重不同 prompt 的 reward 上界差异，避免把低上界样本硬推向不可达的全局目标。方法还区分强弱 reward model：对较可靠的 reward model 使用 online strategy，在训练中动态收集并更新 Pareto frontier；对较弱、容易坍缩的 reward model 使用 offline strategy，先预生成样本并提取 frontier，再作为更稳定的优化目标。评价上，作者提出 Joint Domination Rate 和 Joint Collapse Rate。JDR 衡量样本是否在所有 reward 上同时优于 baseline，JCR 衡量是否在所有 reward 上同时退化，比只看 reward 均值更能反映多目标优化是否真的协同。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 PG-OT 在多 reward 文生图偏好优化上优于强 baseline。关键结果包括：JDR2 达到 47.98%，提升约 11 个百分点；JDR4 达到 17.10%，提升约 3.4 个百分点；JCR4 下降 0.2%，说明在四个 reward 同时退化的样本比例上有所抑制。人工评测中，方法获得接近 80% 的 win rate。实验结论主要支持两点：第一，均值 reward 提升不足以说明对齐质量提升；第二，prompt-specific Pareto frontier 能减少多 reward 优化里的全局目标错配。需要注意的是，全文片段没有展示完整 reward model 组合、训练超参和人评协议，复现时这些细节会决定结论强度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。优先看 Mechanisms Behind Reward Hacking，理解作者如何把 heterogeneous reward bounds 和 unified global target 联系起来。然后看 PG-OT 方法部分，重点是 prompt-specific Pareto frontier 的构造、OT loss 如何进入训练、online/offline 两种策略的适用条件。实验部分重点看 JDR/JCR 与传统均值 reward 指标是否出现分歧。若研究 LLM RL，可以把文生图细节放在次要位置，重点思考它对多任务 reward normalization、per-prompt baseline、难度自适应目标和 reward model 可靠性分层的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies reward hacking in multi-reward preference optimization for text-to-image models. Different prompts induce image domains with different attainable reward ranges, but common methods optimize toward a shared global target or a weighted sum of rewards. This mismatch can increase reward scores while degrading human-perceived quality.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and reward-signal design than to pretraining. Its useful contribution is the diagnosis that reward hacking can be caused by heterogeneous reward upper bounds, not only by weak reward models. The same issue can appear in LLM RLHF or multi-objective alignment: tasks with different difficulty, languages, or domains may not share a single reachable reward target. A global margin, baseline, or scalarized objective can push some samples into regions where the reward model is unreliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Pareto Frontier-Guided Optimal Transport, or PG-OT. Instead of collapsing multiple rewards into a single weighted scalar and maximizing it against one global target, the method builds a prompt-specific Pareto frontier. Generated samples for the same prompt form the source distribution, while the corresponding Pareto frontier is used as the target distribution. Optimal transport then maps the source samples toward that frontier. This design respects prompt-level differences in attainable reward boundaries. The method also separates reward models by reliability. For stronger reward models, it uses an online strategy that dynamically collects and updates Pareto frontiers during training. For weaker reward models that are more prone to collapse, it uses an offline strategy that precomputes samples and extracts frontiers before optimization. The paper also introduces Joint Domination Rate and Joint Collapse Rate. JDR measures whether samples improve over the baseline on all rewards at once, while JCR measures simultaneous degradation on all rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show consistent gains in multi-reward text-to-image alignment. PG-OT reaches 47.98% JDR2, about 11 percentage points higher than the compared baseline, and 17.10% JDR4, about 3.4 points higher. JCR4 decreases by 0.2%, indicating a reduction in samples that collapse across all four rewards. Human evaluation reports a win rate close to 80%. The main empirical message is that average reward scores are not sufficient for judging multi-reward alignment, and that prompt-specific Pareto targets can reduce global-target mismatch. Reproduction would require checking the exact reward model set, training recipe, frontier construction details, and human evaluation protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. Start with the section on the mechanism behind reward hacking, especially the argument about heterogeneous reward bounds and unified global targets. Then read the PG-OT method, focusing on how the prompt-specific Pareto frontier is built, how optimal transport is used as the optimization signal, and when the online or offline strategy is chosen. In the experiments, compare JDR and JCR against mean reward metrics. For LLM RL researchers, the transferable parts are reward normalization, per-prompt or per-task baselines, adaptive targets, and reliability-aware use of reward models.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫§方法和reward hacking实验；若Pareto构造干净，可借来审视LLM多reward RL的标量化假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and reward-hacking experiments; if the Pareto construction is clean, it is a useful stress test for scalarized multi-reward RL in LLMs.

paper.title: Mitigating Cross-Lingual Cultural Inconsistencies in LLMs via Consensus-Driven Preference Optimisation
paper.abstract: Despite their impressive capabilities, multilingual large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit inconsistent behaviour when the prompt's language changes. While such adaptation is generally desirable, it becomes a critical failure when a user's identity is explicitly defined. For instance, given a fixed British persona and an ambiguous everyday knowledge query about literature, the prompt's language frequently overwrites the system persona -- yielding Shakespeare in English but Cervantes in

summary.core_problem: 研究多语言 LLM 在提示语言变化时是否会覆盖显式设定的用户身份，导致文化相关回答不一致。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在对齐与评测：提出 Cross-lingual Cultural Inconsistency 的量化指标 Singleton Fleiss's κ_S，并给出一个偏好优化框架来缓解跨语言文化不一致。它不是预训练方法，但对多语言对齐、persona 保持和奖励信号设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法 C-3PO 使用 consensus-driven preference optimisation：围绕固定身份和多语言提示构造偏好信号，鼓励模型在不同语言下保持与用户身份一致的文化回答。κ_S 被设计为对幻觉更稳健，避免把错误但一致的输出误判为可靠一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 C-3PO 相比未对齐模型最多带来 0.10 的 κ_S 绝对提升，并优于 strong prompting 和 representation steering baselines。摘要未给出具体模型规模、语言覆盖范围、数据量和完整 benchmark 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Cambridge Language Technology Lab 和 University of Copenhagen；Isabelle Augenstein、Anna Korhonen 是多语言 NLP、事实性与语义理解方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether multilingual LLMs let the prompt language override an explicitly specified user identity, producing culturally inconsistent answers.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in alignment and evaluation: it defines Cross-lingual Cultural Inconsistency with Singleton Fleiss's κ_S and proposes a preference-optimization framework to reduce it. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multilingual alignment, persona persistence, and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: C-3PO uses consensus-driven preference optimisation over fixed-persona, multilingual prompts, encouraging the model to preserve identity-conditioned cultural answers across languages. The κ_S metric is designed to be robust to hallucinations, so consistency is not confused with uniformly wrong outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to a 0.10 absolute gain in κ_S over unaligned models and improvements over strong prompting and representation-steering baselines. It does not provide model sizes, language coverage, data scale, or full benchmark details.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from the University of Cambridge Language Technology Lab and the University of Copenhagen. Isabelle Augenstein and Anna Korhonen are well-known researchers in multilingual NLP, factuality, and semantic modeling.

recommendation.zh: 多语言 persona 漂移是实际问题，但方法像对齐补丁；看指标定义和数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: The multilingual persona drift is real, but the method reads like an alignment patch; skim the metric and data construction.

institutions: Language Technology Lab, University of Cambridge

paper.title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization

While preference-based learning offers a promising alignment strategy, it is hindered by unreliable semantic rewards derived from sparse test cases or restrictive reference translations. We argue that a robust semantic reward for code translation must be derived directly from the source code. In this paper, we propose CTO to improve code translation with

paper.title: BSO: Safety Alignment Is Density Ratio Matching
paper.abstract: Aligning language models for both helpfulness and safety typically requires complex pipelines-separate reward and cost models, online reinforcement learning, and primal-dual updates. Recent direct preference optimization approaches simplify training but incorporate safety through ad-hoc modifications such as multi-stage procedures or heuristic margin terms, lacking a principled derivation. We show that the likelihood ratio of the optimal safe policy admits a closed-form decomposition that reduce

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图把安全对齐中的 helpfulness-safety 约束问题改写成一个密度比匹配问题，从而避免 Safe RLHF 那类多阶段流程，也避免 SafeDPO 等方法中较经验化的 margin 或重标注设计。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接影响不大，但对 post-train 方法论有一定价值，尤其是 DPO 系列方法的统一理解。核心贡献是给安全偏好优化一个更干净的推导路径：从 KL 正则约束下的最优安全策略出发，推导策略 likelihood ratio 的分解，再用 Bregman divergence 做 ratio matching。这样的表述有助于比较不同 direct alignment loss 的差异，也有助于理解安全惩罚强度、参考模型和偏好数据分布之间的关系。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 constrained alignment 出发：最大化 helpfulness，同时满足 safety 约束。传统 Safe RLHF 需要 reward model、cost model、在线 RL 和 primal-dual 更新；DPO 简化了 helpfulness 对齐，但安全项往往通过额外阶段、辅助模型或 margin 加进去。BSO 的关键观察是，最优安全策略的 likelihood ratio 可以分解为三部分：reference model ratio、helpfulness preference ratio、safety correction term。于是训练目标变成让模型 ratio 匹配数据 ratio。作者进一步用一族 Bregman divergence 来度量 ratio 差异，不同凸生成函数 h 对应不同 loss。这样得到的 BSO 是单阶段训练方法，不需要额外 reward/cost model，只比 DPO 多一个主要安全强度超参数。论文还声称 SafeDPO 可被看作该框架下的一个特例。
summary.experiments: 从提供的正文可见，论文在多个安全对齐 benchmark 上做了实验，并包含两个关键消融：安全惩罚强度，以及 Bregman generator 的选择。摘要和引言没有给出具体数值，因此不宜把效果幅度说得过满。可以确认的实验结论是：作者试图证明 BSO 在 helpfulness 和 safety 之间取得更稳定的折中，并且不同 generator 会影响训练行为。精读时应核对主表中相对 DPO、SafeDPO、Safe RLHF 或其他安全 DPO 变体的提升，以及拒答率、无害性、帮助性是否同时报告。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟；如果正在做 DPO/RLHF loss 设计，可以精读理论部分。优先看 Background 中 DPO 的重参数化，再看 BSO 推导里最优安全策略 ratio 的三项分解。实验部分重点看安全强度系数的曲线，因为它决定方法是否只是通过更强拒答换取安全分数。还应检查不同 Bregman generator 的消融，看论文是否给出可操作的选择准则，而不是只给一个经验最优配置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reformulates safety alignment as density-ratio matching. It targets the gap between principled constrained RLHF, which is operationally heavy, and direct preference methods for safety, which often add safety through heuristic margins, relabeling, or multi-stage training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly methodological for post-training rather than base pretraining. It provides a cleaner way to derive safety-aware DPO-style objectives from an optimal safe-policy ratio. This is useful for researchers designing alignment losses, because it connects the reference policy, helpfulness preferences, and safety correction in one expression instead of treating safety as an extra penalty bolted onto DPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: BSO starts from constrained alignment: optimize helpfulness under a safety constraint. The key derivation shows that the likelihood ratio of the optimal safe policy decomposes into three interpretable factors: the reference-model ratio, the helpfulness preference ratio, and a safety correction term. Once written this way, training can be cast as matching the model ratio to the target data ratio. The authors then minimize Bregman divergences between these ratios. Each convex generator induces a different single-stage loss. The resulting methods require no separate reward model, no cost model, and no online RL; compared with DPO, the main additional control is the safety penalty strength. The paper also positions SafeDPO as a special case within this ratio-matching family.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the method is evaluated on safety-alignment benchmarks, with ablations over the safety penalty and the choice of Bregman generator. The excerpt does not include exact numbers, so the reported performance should be checked directly in the experimental tables. The important empirical questions are whether BSO improves safety without simply increasing refusals, whether helpfulness remains competitive, and whether the generator choice changes the helpfulness-safety tradeoff in a predictable way.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes, or read the derivation carefully if working on DPO-style objectives. Focus on the section deriving the optimal safe-policy likelihood ratio and the Bregman loss family. In the experiments, prioritize the penalty-strength ablation and the generator ablation. These results determine whether the framework gives practical guidance or mainly offers a unifying theoretical view.

paper.title: TokenRatio: Principled Token-Level Preference Optimization via Ratio Matching
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used RL-free method for aligning language models from pairwise preferences, but it models preferences over full sequences even though generation is driven by per-token decisions. Existing token-level extensions typically decompose a sequence-level Bradley-Terry objective across timesteps, leaving per-prefix (state-wise) optimality implicit. We study how to recover token-level preference optimality using only standard sequence-level pairwise compar

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 preference optimization 里的粒度错配问题。DPO 这类方法用序列级偏好对整段回答建模，但自回归模型在推理时做的是逐 token 决策。已有 token-level 变体大多只是把序列级 Bradley–Terry 目标拆到时间步上，credit assignment 仍然是隐式的，没有真正定义“每个 prefix 下什么 token 更优”。作者想做的是：只用常见的序列级 pairwise preference 数据，也能恢复一个在状态—动作层面更接近最优的策略。
summary.importance: 对 post-training 方法研究，这篇文章的价值主要在理论建模和目标函数设计，而不是工程 recipe。它把 preference learning 从“整段回答谁更好”推进到“给定当前 prefix，下一个 token 的偏好比率应该怎样匹配”，这更贴近语言模型的生成机制。对预训练研究员的启发在于两点。第一，很多对齐目标之所以效率不高，不是数据不够，而是监督粒度和模型决策粒度不一致。第二，sequence-level preference 也许可以通过更好的 ratio matching 形式，间接恢复 token-level 最优性，这对未来把偏好信号并入 mid-training 或 reasoning-oriented continual training 有方法论意义。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 TBPO，Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization。核心不是简单的 token-wise DPO，而是先假设一个 token-level Bradley–Terry 偏好模型：在给定 prefix 状态 s_t 时，不同 next-token action 的相对偏好由某个 token-level score 决定。然后作者把学习问题写成密度比估计，也就是去拟合“偏好动作相对参考分布的 ratio”，并用 Bregman divergence 族来构造目标函数。这样做有两个结果。第一，logistic/DPO loss 只是这个更一般框架下的一个特例，而不是唯一选择。第二，在合适的 score parameterization 下，可以给出 token-level optimality 的理论刻画。

文中给了两个主要实例。TBPO-Q 用 state-action value Q 来定义 token-level score，更接近从局部动作价值出发建模偏好；TBPO-A 用 advantage A 来定义 score，更强调相对当前状态基线的增益。作者沿用 KL-regularized sequential decision 的视角，把 next-token generation 写成 token-level MDP，并借助参考策略下的闭式最优 Q/A 形式，把 sequence-level comparison 数据转成可训练的 token-level ratio matching 目标。与 TDPO、TISDPO 这类方法相比，差别不在于是否把 loss 分摊到 token，而在于它显式定义了 token-level 偏好模型，并证明最小化该目标时恢复的是 token-wise optimal policy，而不是仅仅改善序列级偏好概率。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主张有三类：一是 TBPO 在多个 benchmark、不同 backbone、不同任务上优于强基线；二是训练更稳定；三是相对基线更能保持 response diversity。你给出的全文片段没有包含具体表格和数值，因此不能可靠写出提升百分点、模型规模或数据规模。可以确认的是，作者把比较重点放在 DPO 及其 token-level 扩展上，而不是和 RLHF 做大规模算力对决；论文更像是在同等偏好数据条件下比较目标函数是否更贴近自回归决策。

从方法结构推断，最值得关注的实验应包括：TBPO-Q 与 TBPO-A 的对比，说明 Q-formulation 和 advantage-formulation 哪个更稳；不同 Bregman generator 对训练行为的影响，说明 logistic 不是唯一合理选择；以及长回答或长推理任务上的收益，因为 token-level credit assignment 的优势通常会在长 horizon 更明显。如果完整论文里有 calibration、entropy 或 distinct-n 之类的多样性指标，也应重点看，因为作者明确把“preserving response diversity”作为卖点之一。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓理论主线，不要一开始陷在公式细节里。先看 introduction 和 background，明确作者批评现有 token-level DPO 的点：它们仍然是 sequence-level BT 模型，只是把信号分配到 token。然后看 TBPO 的推导，重点盯三件事：token-level Bradley–Terry 假设是什么；密度比是相对谁定义的；Bregman divergence 为什么能导出一族可替换的 preference loss。接着看 theorem 和 optimality characterization，确认“恢复 token-level optimal policy”的条件是什么，是否依赖模型容量、参考策略支持集或偏好噪声假设。

如果只想判断值不值得后续复现，预计 30 分钟左右足够。若要深入，建议重点看 TBPO-Q/TBPO-A 的差别和实验中的稳定性曲线，因为这决定它更像一个漂亮的理论包装，还是一个真正可落地替代 DPO 的训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a granularity mismatch in preference optimization. DPO and related methods optimize sequence-level preferences over whole completions, while autoregressive language models act one token at a time conditioned on a prefix. Existing token-level variants usually redistribute a sequence-level Bradley–Terry objective across timesteps, but they do not explicitly define what token-level preference optimality should mean at each state. The paper asks whether one can recover a policy that is locally preference-optimal at the prefix level while using only standard sequence-level pairwise comparison data.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual and objective-level rather than recipe-level. The paper is useful because it reframes preference learning as a token-level density-ratio problem instead of a whole-sequence classification problem. That matters for anyone thinking about alignment signals as training targets: if the supervision granularity does not match the model’s decision granularity, optimization can be statistically and behaviorally inefficient. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that sequence-level supervision may still induce token-level optimal behavior if the ratio-matching objective is designed carefully enough. That idea could matter beyond DPO, including mid-training or reasoning-oriented continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed framework is Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization, or TBPO. The starting point is a token-level Bradley–Terry preference model defined over next-token actions conditioned on a prefix state. Instead of treating a completion as an indivisible object, the method assigns a token-level score to each state-action pair and learns the corresponding preference density ratio. The estimation objective is built from a Bregman divergence family, which makes standard logistic-style DPO only one special case rather than the default formulation.

The paper introduces two concrete parameterizations. TBPO-Q defines the token-level score through a state-action value function Q. TBPO-A defines it through an advantage function A, emphasizing relative improvement over the state baseline. The derivation is grounded in a KL-regularized sequential decision formulation of autoregressive generation. Using closed-form expressions for optimal Q or A under a reference policy, the authors derive a token-level ratio-matching loss that can be trained from ordinary sequence-level preference pairs. The claimed theoretical payoff is stronger than prior token-level DPO variants: under the token-level preference model, minimizing the TBPO objective recovers the desired token-wise optimal policy, rather than merely improving a decomposed sequence-level objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper claims three empirical benefits: better alignment than strong baselines across benchmarks and backbones, improved training stability, and better preservation of response diversity. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables, exact model sizes, dataset sizes, or numerical gains, so precise figures should not be fabricated. What is clear from the text is that the empirical comparison is centered on DPO-style baselines and token-level extensions such as TDPO and TISDPO, not on a large-scale RLHF comparison.

The most informative experiments to inspect in the full paper are likely these: TBPO-Q versus TBPO-A, to understand whether value-based or advantage-based scoring is more robust; ablations over different Bregman generators, to test whether the generalized objective family matters in practice; and long-generation settings, where token-level credit assignment should matter most. Diversity metrics are also important because the paper explicitly claims better diversity retention than baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a theory-and-objective paper first, not as an engineering recipe. Start with the introduction and background to understand the critique of prior token-level preference methods: they still inherit a sequence-level Bradley–Terry model and only redistribute the signal over time. Then move to the TBPO derivation and focus on three questions: what exactly is the token-level Bradley–Terry assumption, how is the density ratio defined, and why does a Bregman-divergence formulation produce a family of usable preference losses. After that, read the theorem and optimality characterization carefully. The key issue is under what assumptions the minimizer corresponds to a token-level optimal policy.

A quick read should take about 30 minutes. A deeper read should focus on the difference between TBPO-Q and TBPO-A and on the training-stability plots, because those determine whether the method is mainly a cleaner theoretical framing or a practical replacement for standard DPO.

summary.core_problem: 现有偏好优化方法（如DPO）会诱导模型依赖训练数据中的伪相关特征（如回复长度、礼貌程度等表面属性），导致分布偏移下的泛化失效，此前研究仅观测到现象，缺乏统一的理论机制分析和可证明的缓解方案。
summary.importance: 从理论层面解释了对齐阶段伪相关学习的结构性根源，为提升偏好优化的分布鲁棒性、减少对齐后的谄媚、长度偏见等问题提供了有理论依据的指导，同时打通了预训练与对齐阶段分布鲁棒性的研究链路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建log-linear DPO的理论分析框架，证明伪相关学习来自训练分布中的平均伪偏置、因果-伪特征相关泄漏两个结构性通道，且仅靠增加同分布训练数据无法消除分布偏移带来的误差；提出平局训练（Tie Training）数据增强策略，通过加入效用相同但伪特征不同的偏好对，选择性正则化伪参数而不影响因果特征的学习。
summary.experiments: 线性模型实验结果与理论推导定量吻合，神经网络和大语言模型实验验证了机制定性成立，平局训练可有效减少模型对伪相关的依赖，同时不降低同分布下的任务精度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的问题定义和核心贡献，第4-6章的核心理论结论，以及第7章的主要实验结果，预计阅读时间30-40分钟，无需深究理论证明细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing preference optimization methods such as DPO induce models to rely on spurious correlations in training data (e.g., response length, politeness), leading to generalization failure under distribution shift. Prior work only observed this phenomenon, lacking unified theoretical mechanism analysis and provable mitigation strategies.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically explains the structural root cause of spurious correlation learning during alignment, provides theoretically grounded guidance for improving the distributional robustness of preference optimization and reducing post-alignment issues such as sycophancy and length bias, and connects distributional robustness research across pretraining and alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first builds a theoretical analysis framework for log-linear DPO, proving that spurious correlation learning arises from two structural channels in the training distribution: mean spurious bias and causal-spurious correlation leakage, and that scaling in-distribution training data alone cannot eliminate error caused by distribution shift. It then proposes Tie Training, a data augmentation strategy that adds preference pairs with equal utility but different spurious features, to selectively regularize spurious parameters without impairing causal feature learning.
summary_en.experiments: Linear model experiments quantitatively match theoretical derivations, neural network and LLM experiments verify the qualitative mechanism holds, and Tie Training effectively reduces model reliance on spurious correlations without degrading in-distribution task accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition and core contributions in Chapter 1, key theoretical conclusions in Chapters 4-6, and main experimental results in Chapter 7. Estimated reading time is 30-40 minutes, no need to dive into detailed theoretical proofs.

recommendation.zh: DPO伪相关的机制推导扎实，tie训练思路可直接引入内部对齐pipeline做ablation，重点看§3的理论部分。
recommendation.en: The mechanism derivation of spurious correlation in DPO is rigorous; the tie training idea can be directly introduced to internal alignment pipelines for ablation, focus on §3 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: Diffusion-APO: Trajectory-Aware Direct Preference Alignment for Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Efficiently aligning large-scale video diffusion models with human intent requires a scalable and trajectory-aware pathway that bridges the inherent discrepancy between training noise distributions and practical inference trajectories. While existing paradigms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) attempt to address this, they are often hindered by either reliance on bias-prone, complex reward models or suboptimal timestep sampling. In this pa

summary.core_problem: 现有针对扩散模型的直接偏好优化（DPO）存在训练时间步采样与推理去噪轨迹不匹配的问题，导致梯度信号效率低；而依赖奖励模型的GRPO等方法受限于视频奖励模型不成熟、易引入偏差，缺乏适配视频扩散Transformer的轨迹感知偏好对齐方案。
summary.importance: 解决了扩散模型偏好对齐中训练-推理轨迹不匹配的通用问题，不仅适用于视频生成场景，也对文本扩散LLM的DPO对齐有参考价值；提出的多阶段模块化对齐框架可以为生成式大模型的全生命周期对齐提供可复用的流程设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Diffusion-APO算法，通过将训练时的噪声分布与推理时的去噪轨迹同步，解决传统扩散DPO的时间步采样错位问题，提升梯度信号效率；不需要显式标量奖励模型，避免了奖励模型带来的不稳定和偏差。在此基础上构建统一模块化框架，支持在线DPO（推理环反馈+预训练排序模型）、半在线DPO（平衡在线探索和离线缓存稳定性）、离线DPO（最终阶段精调）、感知蒸馏的DPO（缓解推理加速带来的对齐漂移）四个阶段，所有阶段共用一致的Diffusion-APO目标，保证理论一致性。
summary.experiments: 实验显示Diffusion-APO在生成保真度和指令遵循能力上持续优于标准DPO，同时可以同时优化基线模型和加速版本，在不同部署场景下都能保持高质量生成。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言部分对现有扩散DPO核心缺陷的分析，方法部分的轨迹对齐核心逻辑，以及多阶段对齐框架的设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing direct preference optimization (DPO) for diffusion models suffers from timestep sampling misalignment between training noise schedules and inference denoising trajectories, leading to low gradient signal efficacy. Meanwhile, reward-model-based methods like GRPO are limited by the immaturity of video reward models and are prone to introducing biases, with no mature trajectory-aware preference alignment solution tailored for video diffusion transformers.
summary_en.importance: It addresses the common train-inference trajectory misalignment problem in preference alignment for diffusion models, which is applicable not only to video generation but also provides reference for DPO alignment of text diffusion LLMs. The proposed multi-stage modular alignment framework offers a reusable workflow design for full-lifecycle alignment of generative large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion-APO is proposed to resolve the timestep misalignment in conventional diffusion DPO by synchronizing training noise distributions with inference denoising trajectories, thus improving gradient signal efficacy. It does not require an explicit scalar reward model, avoiding instability and biases introduced by reward models. A unified modular framework is built upon Diffusion-APO, supporting four stages: online DPO with in-the-loop feedback from a pre-trained ranker, half-online DPO balancing on-policy exploration and offline buffer stability, offline DPO for final-stage refinement, and distillation-aware DPO mitigating alignment drift caused by inference acceleration. All stages share the consistent Diffusion-APO objective to ensure theoretical coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show Diffusion-APO consistently outperforms standard DPO in generation fidelity and instruction following. It can optimize both baseline models and accelerated versions, maintaining high-quality generation across diverse deployment scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, focus on the analysis of limitations of existing diffusion DPO in the introduction, the core logic of trajectory alignment in the methodology, and the design of the multi-stage framework. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看它怎么把“训练采样=推理轨迹”落到diffusion偏好优化（方法段+采样策略）；若实验没严格控住采样/算力，结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Focus on how they enforce “training sampling = inference trajectory” for diffusion preference optimization; treat claims as weak unless sampling/compute are tightly controlled.

paper.title: Beyond Pairs: Your Language Model is Secretly Optimizing a Preference Graph
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models using pairwise preference comparisons, offering a simple and effective alternative to Reinforcement Learning (RL) from human feedback. However, in many practical settings, training data consists of multiple rollouts per prompt, inducing rich preference structure that pairwise DPO fails to exploit. Collapsing such data into independent pairs discards transitivity, introduces redundant or conflicting supervision, and can lead to unstable

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多 rollout 偏好数据的训练目标问题：实际对齐数据常常是同一 prompt 下多个回答的排序、并列或部分可比关系，而标准 DPO 把它们拆成独立 pair，丢掉了全局结构，也会引入冗余和冲突监督。
summary.importance: 它更偏 post-train，但和基座研究的接口很近。当前推理、代码和数学训练大量依赖多次采样、验证器打分、候选排序和自举数据。如果训练目标只能看 pairwise comparison，就会浪费 rollout 结构，也可能放大噪声偏好。GraphDPO 的价值在于把偏好信号从“成对分类”提升为“图结构约束”，对研究 SFT/RL 数据质量、偏好目标稳定性、verified rollout 利用方式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GraphDPO 为每个 prompt 的多个候选回答构造有向无环偏好图。节点是 responses，边表示 dominance relation；并列回答被放进 equivalence classes，不强行制造严格顺序。目标函数借鉴 Plackett-Luce ranking，但不要求完整全序排列。每个较优回答只和它支配的更差回答集合做 groupwise 对比，通过 log-sum-exp 聚合 dominated samples。pairwise DPO 可以看作单边图的特例，严格 listwise ranking 可以看作分层 DAG 的特例。在线性复杂度的 layered DAG 构造下，它避免枚举 O(K^2) pairwise comparisons，也不需要对所有排列做归一化。对于存在标准答案或验证解的任务，方法还支持 oracle anchoring：把 oracle response 作为支配节点加入图中，并使用 annealed schedule，训练早期增强锚定信号，后期逐步降低权重。
summary.experiments: 论文在 GSM8K、MATH 和 APPS 上评估，覆盖数学推理和程序合成。给出的描述是 GraphDPO 相比 pairwise DPO、listwise baselines 和 rollout-based alignment methods 表现更稳定，并且在多 rollout 训练设置下有更好的 scaling behavior。提供的全文片段没有包含具体表格数值、模型尺寸、rollout 数量或提升幅度，因此不适合补写精确数字。可确认的实验信息是：任务选择强调可验证或可排序输出，正好对应 GraphDPO 的 preference DAG 和 oracle anchoring 设计。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 objective derivation、preference DAG 构造、ties/partial order 的处理方式，以及 oracle anchoring 的退火策略。实验部分优先看不同 rollout 数量下的曲线、和 DPO/listwise 方法的对比、以及是否有关于 preference noise 或 tie handling 的消融。如果只关心预训练，可跳过常规 benchmark 描述，重点吸收它对训练信号结构化建模的思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in preference optimization. In many alignment pipelines, each prompt has multiple rollouts with rankings, ties, or partial comparability. Standard DPO reduces this structure to independent pairs, losing transitivity and introducing redundant or conflicting supervision.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers through the training-signal interface. Reasoning, code, and math pipelines increasingly rely on multiple rollouts, verifiers, and ranked candidate sets. A pairwise objective may underuse that structure and amplify noisy comparisons. GraphDPO treats preference data as a graph rather than as isolated binary labels, which is a useful direction for thinking about data quality, reward-free alignment, verified rollouts, and stable preference learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each prompt, GraphDPO constructs a directed acyclic preference graph over candidate responses. Edges encode dominance relations, while ties are represented as equivalence classes instead of being forced into an artificial total order. The objective is inspired by Plackett-Luce ranking, but it operates over dominated neighborhoods rather than full permutations. Each response is contrasted against the set of strictly worse responses it dominates, using a log-sum-exp aggregation. Pairwise DPO becomes a single-edge special case, and strict listwise ranking becomes a layered-DAG special case. Under the equivalence-class layered construction, the objective has linear complexity in the number of responses and avoids enumerating O(K^2) pairs. When verified or oracle solutions are available, the method adds them as dominant nodes and uses an annealed anchoring schedule: strong oracle supervision early in training, then weaker anchoring later to preserve flexibility.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates GraphDPO on GSM8K, MATH, and APPS, covering mathematical reasoning and program synthesis. The provided content reports consistent gains and more robust scaling compared with pairwise DPO, listwise baselines, and rollout-based alignment methods. Exact numbers, model sizes, rollout counts, and ablation tables are not present in the supplied full-text excerpt, so they should be checked directly in the experimental section. The task selection is well matched to the method because these domains naturally produce verifiable, ranked, or partially ordered candidate responses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on the preference-DAG construction, the derivation of the graph-structured objective, handling of ties and partial orders, and the annealed oracle anchoring mechanism. In the experiments, prioritize curves over the number of rollouts, comparisons against DPO and listwise objectives, and ablations on tie handling or anchoring. Readers focused on pretraining can skip routine benchmark discussion and retain the idea of modeling supervision as structured constraints rather than independent pairs.

recommendation.zh: 值得看目标函数推导；如果内部偏好数据本来是 ranked rollout，pairwise DPO 可能浪费了结构信号。
recommendation.en: Read the objective derivation; if your preference data starts as ranked rollouts, pairwise DPO is likely throwing away usable structure.

summary_en.experiments: Outperforms baseline DPO method on text-to-image generation preference alignment tasks, specific improvement metrics are not specified in the given abstract

paper.title: A Unified Pair-GRPO Family: From Implicit to Explicit Preference Constraints for Stable and General RL Alignment
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) alignment via reinforcement learning from human preferences (RLHF) suffers from unstable policy updates, ambiguous gradient directions, poor interpretability, and high gradient variance in mainstream pairwise preference learning paradigms. To systematically address these limitations, we establish a unified theoretical framework for preference-based RL optimization centered on the Pair-GRPO family, comprising two tightly coupled variants: Soft-Pair-GRPO and Hard-Pair-GR

summary.core_problem: 如何解决主流 RLHF（如 GRPO）中由于使用连续标量奖励导致的策略更新不稳定、梯度方向模糊和方差大的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的 Pair-GRPO 框架，将隐式的标量奖励替换为显式的二元偏好约束，在理论上证明了其与 GRPO 的梯度等价性，并提供了更稳定的对齐优化路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Pair-GRPO 家族，包含 Soft-Pair-GRPO 和 Hard-Pair-GRPO。Soft-Pair-GRPO 将 GRPO 中的组归一化标量奖励替换为二元成对偏好奖励（+1/-1），保留了裁剪替代目标和 KL 正则化结构。Hard-Pair-GRPO 进一步引入显式的局部概率约束，消除全局漂移并降低梯度方差。
summary.experiments: 在 LLM 对齐和连续控制 RL 任务上验证了 Pair-GRPO 家族的有效性，证明了其在稳定性和收敛速度上的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Section 4 中关于 Soft-Pair-GRPO 的梯度等价性定理（Gradient Equivalence Theorem），这是理解该方法为什么有效（即使丢弃了连续奖励幅度）的核心。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the unstable policy updates, ambiguous gradient directions, and high variance in mainstream RLHF (like GRPO) caused by the use of continuous scalar rewards?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified Pair-GRPO framework that replaces implicit scalar rewards with explicit binary preference constraints, theoretically proving its gradient equivalence to GRPO and providing a more stable alignment optimization path.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Pair-GRPO family, comprising Soft-Pair-GRPO and Hard-Pair-GRPO. Soft-Pair-GRPO replaces the group-normalized scalar rewards in GRPO with binary pairwise preference rewards (+1/-1), retaining the clipped surrogate objective and KL-regularized structure. Hard-Pair-GRPO further introduces explicit local probability constraints to eliminate global drift and reduce gradient variance.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of the Pair-GRPO family on LLM alignment and continuous-control RL tasks, demonstrating its advantages in stability and convergence speed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 4, focusing on the Gradient Equivalence Theorem for Soft-Pair-GRPO. This is the core to understanding why the method works despite discarding continuous reward magnitudes. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 理论推导干净，Pair-GRPO的梯度等价结论可直接用于优化内部RLHF的奖励设计，重点看梯度等价定理的证明部分。
recommendation.en: The theoretical derivation is clean; the gradient equivalence conclusion of Pair-GRPO can be directly used to optimize internal RLHF reward design, focus on the proof of the gradient equivalence theorem.

summary.core_problem: 视觉生成模型的人类反馈对齐通常依赖成对偏好标注，无法直接利用独立标量评分，限制了对齐的可扩展性
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了可直接基于标量反馈开展生成模型对齐的框架，降低了对齐的标注成本

paper.title: Data-dependent Exploration for Online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper.abstract: Online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs) by continuously collecting new preference feedback during training. A foundational challenge in this setting is exploration, which requires algorithms that enable the LLMs to generate informative comparisons that improve sample-efficiency in online RLHF. Existing exploration strategies often derive bonuses via on-policy expectations, which are difficult to estima

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 online RLHF 中的探索效率问题。关键矛盾是：模型训练时只能看到沿历史策略收集到的偏好比较，覆盖很不均匀；如果探索奖励依赖当前策略的 on-policy 期望，估计会很噪，模型可能过早压低一些尚未充分验证的响应区域。DEPO 想解决的是如何用历史偏好数据本身刻画覆盖不足，并把这种不确定性稳定地注入偏好优化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在 post-train 侧，尤其是 online alignment 和数据闭环。它的贡献不是提出新的语言建模目标，而是把 bandit/RL 中的 data-dependent UCB 思路迁移到 RLHF 数据采集：让模型不只优化当前偏好估计，也主动补齐表示空间中覆盖薄的方向。这个问题会影响 SFT/RL 数据效率，也会影响后续把在线反馈用于 continual post-training 的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 DEPO，即 Data-dependent Exploration for Preference Optimization。论文假设偏好满足 Bradley-Terry 模型，并在一个已知特征空间中表示单个回答；一对回答被拼成 pairwise feature。历史偏好比较会形成一个覆盖矩阵，类似线性 bandit 中的 design matrix。对新回答对，DEPO 根据该方向在历史数据中的覆盖程度计算 confidence radius：覆盖少的方向半径大，覆盖多的方向半径小。这个半径作为 UCB 探索 bonus，被加到偏好优化目标中，形成 reward bias。与依赖当前策略分布期望的探索方法相比，DEPO 的探索信号直接来自已收集数据的几何结构，因此更不容易因为当前策略短期收缩而丢掉未探索区域。论文还给出 data-dependent regret bound，界会随实际采样轨迹的表示几何变化，而不是只给最坏情形保证。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个 online RLHF 基线上有稳定提升，并强调 DEPO 计算开销较小、支持在线更新。已给出的全文片段没有包含实验章节的具体表格，因此无法确认模型规模、prompt 数量、反馈轮数、胜率提升或消融数值。可确认的实验关注点应包括：与被动探索、on-policy bonus 探索、标准偏好优化方法的比较；探索 bonus 的消融；历史覆盖矩阵更新方式对性能和稳定性的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法定义中 pairwise feature、coverage matrix、confidence radius 和 reward bias 的公式，这决定了它是否能落到真实 LLM 训练里。其次看 regret bound 的依赖项，重点看它如何从 worst-case 复杂度变成 data-dependent 复杂度。实验部分如果可读到，应重点看三类图表：在线轮次上的 win rate 曲线、反馈样本效率曲线、bonus/覆盖度消融。实现层面需要关注 feature map 来自哪里；如果特征只是 reward model 或 LLM hidden state，表示漂移会是主要工程问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies exploration in online RLHF. The core issue is that preference data are collected along the training trajectory and have uneven coverage. Exploration bonuses based on on-policy expectations are hard to estimate from such limited historical data, so the policy may prematurely suppress response regions that are under-explored but potentially high value.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to the post-training side of the pretrain-posttrain loop. It does not introduce a new language modeling objective, but it gives a cleaner way to make online preference collection more sample-efficient. The useful idea is to measure uncertainty from the geometry of historical comparisons rather than from the current policy alone. This matters for online alignment, continual preference training, and any pipeline where the model’s own sampling distribution determines future supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: DEPO, Data-dependent Exploration for Preference Optimization, builds a UCB-style exploration bonus from historical preference comparisons. The preference oracle is modeled with a Bradley-Terry form. Each response has a feature representation, and a response pair is represented by a concatenated pairwise feature. Historical comparisons define a coverage matrix over this feature space. For a new comparison, the method computes a confidence radius that is large along poorly covered directions and small along well-covered ones. This radius is injected into the preference optimization objective as a reward bias. Compared with exploration schemes based on on-policy expectations, the signal is tied to observed data coverage, so it is less sensitive to short-term policy collapse. The paper also provides a data-dependent regret bound that adapts to the representation geometry induced by the collected trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains over online RLHF baselines and positions DEPO as lightweight enough for online updates. The provided text does not include the experimental tables, so concrete numbers such as model size, feedback budget, win-rate gains, or ablation magnitudes cannot be verified here. The key experimental evidence to look for is comparison against passive exploration, on-policy bonus methods, and standard preference optimization, plus ablations on the bonus and the historical coverage estimator.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-30 minute skim is enough. Focus first on the definitions of the pairwise feature, coverage matrix, confidence radius, and how the bonus enters the preference objective. Then check the regret theorem and its dependence on empirical coverage rather than only worst-case dimensions. If the experimental section is available, prioritize learning curves over online rounds, feedback-efficiency plots, and ablations of the exploration bonus. A practical point to examine is the source and stability of the feature map; if it comes from a changing reward model or LLM representation, representation drift becomes a key implementation concern.

recommendation.zh: 在线 RLHF 的探索机制是当前对齐研究的痛点，本文用历史数据构建 uncertainty bonus 的思路值得关注，可作为改进 DPO/PPO 探索的参考。
recommendation.en: Exploration in online RLHF is a current pain point; the idea of using historical data to construct uncertainty bonuses is worth noting for improving DPO/PPO exploration.
